chapters.title: Chapter 348
chapters.content:
C348 – Third Lock
Posted on April 5, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
After fleeing Snowfield City, Shao Xuan recalled the maps he had seen in the stone room. He had no intention of going to any of the cities in the desert. Now, no city was peaceful. Besides, the slave owners never had a good attitude towards the tribemen, even Su Lun has another purpose with his cooperation.
Therefore, the route Shao Xuan was now taking was not in contact with any of the cities under the control of a slave owner. As far as possible, he wanted to get away from those troubles.
Originally, Shao Xuan also wanted to go to the seaside to take a look. The plan of this route would lead to the nearest sea to Snowfield City. However, Shao Xuan had noticed those who were chasing behind him, so he could only put down his other thoughts and flee again.
There were 200 Jinjiawei. If Shao Xuan wanted to deal with them, he could break them up, but this group was the Jinjiawei who almost do not act separately. They probably know their own shortcomings. The Jinjiawei acted completely as a whole, which meant Shao Xuan could not find an opportunity to attack.
Moreover, Shao Xuan could feel that those Jinjiawei were like dead people, seemingly unafraid to keep chasing until the completion of their task.
If there was a way to deal with those Bi Luos too, Shao Xuan would not have these pursuers chasing him. However, those Bi Luos were very clever, never far away from the Jinjiawei. After a discovery of abnormalities, they would hide within the Jinjiawei team.
It’s difficult, really difficult.
Since entering the desert, this was the first time Shao Xuan was being hunted, which was embarrassing. He fled fast, but those Bi Luos were always able to find him accurately. No matter how he used his clothes as a dummy and applied other smells to his body, he could not shake off the Bi Luos.
No wonder the blind old slave had said: Once he was targeted by the Bi Luo, it would be hard to escape.
He couldn’t think of any good way to escape at the moment. Shao Xuan could only use his speed as an advantage to ease his dilemma.
He thought of taking this group to other cities, and let them kill each other. Then, before Shao Xuan could wait for a chance to lead these people there, he met two teams from Shaqi City and Skywheel City, fighting. Contrary to Shao Xuan’s expectations though, when the three teams met, they did not continue the fight each other, but grouped up together to catch Shao Xuan.
This gave Shao Xuan even more of a headache.
The two teams changed their goal and followed the Jinjiawei. They felt that, since Snowfield City had sent the Jinjiawei to hunt down a man, that man must have been special.
What was special about him? Was it because he stole something good from Snowfield City?
Everyone wanted to make a profit. The people of Shaqi City and Skywheel City also did not want to fight with each other, thinking that catching the person in front who might have taken a treasure, then going back to their city afterwards to give it to their king would render more benefits.
With a glimpse of his chasers, Shao Xuan did not expect to have them fight now. His mind was only thinking of figuring out how to get out of this trouble.
He had long since left the area under the jurisdiction of Snowfield City. Without the snow, the surrounding desert was under high temperatures.
Shao Xuan stepped on the scorching, hot sand under his feet and went under the shadows on the back of the sand dunes for a little rest. There was not much time he could use for rest.
Sha sha sha!
A large chunk of sand on the dunes slid.
Shao Xuan looked in that direction, while hiding his presence well even if he had not seen any big movements at that time. Shao Xuan could not be aware of every beast in the desert every time, as some beasts were hidden under the sand. When they had hidden very well, even Shao Xuan who had been fleeing had almost stepped on the snake and scorpion bodies that were buried under the sand.
The difference was that at this moment, it was not a small beast that had crawled out of the dunes. It was a behemoth.
When Shao Xuan had seen the movement, he had already retreated earlier to avoid it.
Pu—
The beast snorted and two sand arrows ejected from its nostrils, piercing into the sand not far away from Shao Xuan.
Looking at the figure that came out, Shao Xuan had a sense of familiarity.
The beast, after coming out of the sand dune after a sleep, became aware of someone nearby. It immediately became disgruntled, letting out a scream, making the wind and sand rush out. However, when it saw Shao Xuan’s appearance, its roar stopped.
The horned lizard beast caught half roar: “…”
Shao Xuan: “…”
If he was not in a difficult situation right now, Shao Xuan really wanted to say hello to this one: Yo, long time no see.
This beast was the horned lizard beast that he had encountered at the Colosseum. However, it had no red marks around its eyes this time, which was probably washed away by the sand.
At the beginning of the chaos in Beast City, a lot of unowned monsters ran, including this one, out of the Colosseum. Shao Xuan previously had a confrontation with the horned lizard beast, but he did not expect to meet it here.
Shao Xuan was also worried about the horned lizard beast’s revenge, hence he wanted to avoid an encounter. However, the horned lizard beast was actually more worried than Shao Xuan. At that time in the Colosseum, that feeling of fear was still clear in its mind. It had not mainly looked at the other’s appearance, but also the breath and power fluctuating around him.
One man and one beast were in a deadlock, guarding against each other, until a blue beetle drilled out of the ground. This caused the heavy atmosphere at the moment to break.
The horned lizard turned and took the chance to ran away. This made Shao Xuan breath a sigh of relief, then he focused his attention on Sapphire.
At the start of its successful enslavement, this beetle was just pushing dung balls, but now, even with his back armor as bright as a gem, it could move stealthily better than Shao Xuan. He did not know what it had encountered under the sand, but its back armor has a deep concave. If it went a little deeper, there would be a danger to its life. Even if its injury was not life-threatening for the time being, it was still a heavy injury for the beetle. Its wings were damaged and it was no longer able to fly.
Although most of the time, it was active on the ground or under the sand, in the event of a critical situation, it could also fly to avoid disaster. Now though, if the beetle once again encountered a desert beast, regardless of how big or even just slightly fierce, it could also pose a great threat to it.
Shao Xuan also knew that Sapphire was with a lot of beetles. However, the other beetles couldn’t keep up with it and fell far behind.
Shao Xuan did not know the scale of Sapphire’s insect army, but he can be sure that, based on the size he had seen the previous time, they would still be unable to block 200 Jinjiawei. With the addition of the two other cities, there was no hope.
After carefully looking at Sapphire’s injury, Shao Xuan did not know what to do. If it was a wolf or a lion or other animals, he had knowledge of its treatment. However, the bug’s injury was unfamiliar to him.
“What are we going to do with this injury?” Shao Xuan looked at the wound on the Sapphire’s back and sighed.
Sapphire crawled on the ground and climbed next to Shao Xuan, but it do not know how to express its thoughts. It could only go around Shao Xuan in a circle.
Fortunately, Shao Xuan could understand a little bit of what’s on its mind.
“Unlock you again?” Shao Xuan was not so reassured. How long was it that its second lock was unraveled? Unlocking the third lock now, could it handle it? If it couldn’t control the power in its body, it would die.
But looking at Sapphire’s injury, then looking at its careful and ardent actions, Shao Xuan still decided to grant its wish.
If the third lock was unlocked, the injury on its body might be healed. It should be worth it for such an injury…
Same as when Caesar was seriously injured, Shao Xuan had engraved its seal. Perhaps unlocking had the same effect.
It was just that it’s too risky. A single carelessness, and it could lead to failure.
Soon, the blue flame came out of his hand. Shao Xuan concentrated as much as possible, controlling his power to unlock.
Looking at the excitedly pedalling blue beetle, Shao Xuan thought to himself: I can only wish you good luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 349
chapters.content:
C349 – Falling into the Sea
Posted on April 8, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
After the third lock was successfully unlocked, he could only leave it to Sapphire.
Originally, Shao Xuan thought he would be able to get the results in a short time. However, after unraveling the third lock, Sapphire went into a sleep-like state. It had no reaction to the outside world, under a state similar to hibernation.
Shao Xuan was not at ease. He planned to wait longer, but he heard the Jinjiawei’s movement.
Shao Xuan had some admiration for the obsession of those chasing him.
This was already the tenth day. In addition to looking for food and a short rest, the rest of the Jinjiawei’s time was in pursuit. Not only those Jinjiawei, even what they’re riding that look like camels or horses also have excellent patience. They were cold and heat resistant, could carry weight and last for a long time running. As for Shaqi City and Skywheel City who had been following closely behind the Jinjiawei, they were being left the farther away they had chased.
Seeing that Sapphire still has not moved, Shao Xuan chose not to carry it while running away. After all, those people and beasts chasing him were not after the beetle. Lifting Sapphire, he placed it on the sand dunes and dug the sand around Sapphire to cover it.
The Bi Luos identified that their target was Shao Xuan, therefore, for other things aside from Shao Xuan, they did not care at all and ignored.
The team chased Shao Xuan, bringing up a burst of dust. The Bi Luos issued a sharp crying sound, flapping its wings and pointing its long nose straight at Shao Xuan.
When the dust dissipated, the place was restored to its original appearance. The violent wind scraped the sand from the sand dunes to other places. Soon, there was no sign of movement.
Shao Xuan felt like he had found this dead end on his own.
Escaping to the left, he’d face the jurisdiction of Shaqi City, to the right was the position of Skywheel City. Moreover, he was now able to see some minimal growth in the numbers of Skywheel City.
Shao Xuan also could not determine what he had been thinking, running this way in a daze. Waiting for a miracle, only to find that he had stupidly put himself in a dead end. He knew that he should not be negligent of his escape. The desert was so huge, that even if he took a detour to the back of those Jinjiawei, then he could still find a chance to run back and break open this situation. However, after he had a run up, Shao Xuan felt his consciousness being controlled, directly making him run forward.
There were birds flying in the sky. It was not the wild birds in the desert, but the domesticated birds of the people of Skywheel City. There were even people on the backs of the birds.
Although Skywheel City has not launched a fierce large-scale war with other cities and only had a small friction with Shaqi City, they were also affected by the tension in the desert. Every day, there were long-distance patrol teams out to search. Now, Shao Xuan had encountered these Skywheel City patrol team.
On the right, there was the Skywheel City patrol team with an ambush. Behind was the pursuit of the Jinjiawei, while in front, was a cliff by the sea.
Normally, it would be the time for a normal person to run to the left. However, Shao Xuan actually ran straight ahead.
At the moment, Shao Xuan felt his legs were not like his own, uncontrollably running straight forward. His mind did not think of other stuff, until the moment he jumped. Shao Xuan suddenly woke up. Unfortunately, he had already jumped…
“I’m an idiot…”
Jumping from a height, he fell hard into the blue sea and sank.
Shao Xuan felt as if someone was dragging him down as he continued falling straight under water.
The surrounding sea water’s temperature was much lower compared to the desert outside. From the hot sand to coming suddenly in contact with the sea water, the more he sunk, the colder he felt. The difference made Shao Xuan shiver uncontrollably. Originally, he had intended to go upstream but found that his actions had little effect.
The surrounding water current was too strong.
Such a current made Shao Xuan’s scalp numb. He was too aware of what such a current represented. It had choked his breath and hindered the movements of his arms.
Thereupon, a huge figure from afar came near. The light dropping from above the sea allowed Shao Xuan to see the markings on it, as well as the fangs that are exposed from that huge mouth. Shao Xuan couldn’t even match one of the other’s teeth.
It has no claws, but its fin-shaped limbs did not lower the power of this beast. Then, being stared at by those eyes, the timid probably would have all his soul fly away. The other side seemed uninterested in Shao Xuan’s little presence, and just swam around but was not leaving.
What made Shao Xuan even more desperate was that, after he stopped struggling, he dropped faster. Even if his ability to hold his breath was good, it was impossible to keep it up indefinitely under the sea.
If he went on like this, he won’t be able to leave here alive.
At this time, on the cliff above the sea, the Jinjiawei that had closely chased him had gathered on the edge of the cliff, looking at the endless blue ocean. They did not follow and jump down. They were not that brainless. How could they go down, just to look for death?
The riding beasts seemed to feel the pressure beneath the sea and treaded uneasily on their hooves.
Soothing their riding beasts, the Jinjiawei led everyone out to guard separately, seeing that Shao Xuan could not run nor take off now.
Meanwhile, the people of Skywheel City ambushing in the sky were stunned by Shao Xuan’s move. Unexpectedly, he just ran straight to the cliff and jumped from above! Was this wishing for death or something else?
The beast in the sea seemed to perceive that there were many people moving on top of the cliff, which made it very unhappy. It went out of the water and flipped over, giving a roar that made the rocks on the cliff almost fall.
Even if they were not afraid that they’d fall, the Jinjiawei could not help but move their riding beasts back several steps. Not far away, the patrol team in the sky moved more simply, directly backing off by 100 meters. As they had long been living near this area, they knew exactly what’s down there. It’s an unshakable creature, far from being comparable to the monsters of the desert.
The Jinjiawei, who was ordered by the king to kill the intruder, lingered on the edge of the cliff for two days. When they did not see Shao Xuan again, they inferred that Shao Xuan should have been swallowed by the sea beast. Therefore, did they indirectly completed the king’s orders?
On the third day, the Jinjiawei moved out with a wave of a hand, “Let’s go back! The task is done, and it’s natural that we go back.”
As for the patrol team of Skywheel City, they would have liked to rob the Jinjiawei of their body equipment, but in the end, still did not have the guts. They hesitated a bit, then saw the Jinjiawei had already gone far.
“Forget it. Let’s wait for a chance next time,” said a man from Skywheel City. They did not have many people in this patrol team. Their number was not much more than the Jinjiawei, so if they really wanted to fight, they might lose.
“Do you think that the man who jumped was eaten by the beast, or he just sank?” Someone asked.
“Forget him. He’s just a madman.”
The patrol team of Skywheel City also returned. Their trip was still calm. The road to their city was also smooth, while the Jinjiawei on the other side was not as lucky. They returned along the original path they took but they were blocked by a group of bugs.
Looking around, large swathes of black beetles covered the sand.
Peng!
On a sand dune, the yellow sand exploded.
A blue-shelled figure gradually emerged, and another beetle made an appearance. The originally calm wave of black bugs surged up like waves.
On the side of Snowfield City, there was a heavy loss since someone had attacked the palace. The rarely wounded Snowfield King was sitting with an inscrutable face. He calculated the number of days, thinking why the Jinjiawei he had sent out had not come back yet.
Go, Sapphire! ?(*′▽`*)?

chapters.title: Chapter 350
chapters.content:
C350 – Changes Under the Sea
Posted on April 13, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
When he dispatched the Jinjiawei, the Snowfield King had told them not to come back if they haven’t killed the intruder. However, as he was really angry then, if the intruder was not killed by the hard-trained Jinjiawei, he would not accept their return. What he did not expect, however, was that his angry remark became true.
The Jinjiawei’s solo combat effectiveness was really not great. They were good at fighting in a group, but they had only fought against people and large desert beasts, not those small ones who could be flexible and drill between their armors and clothing like bugs.
At the moment amidst an insect tide attack, the always calm Jinjiawei also panicked. Their formation could not be maintained. Their riding beasts also became manic from being bitten by the bugs. Even if they turned left to avoid the swarm, in a flash, the right side would also be blocked. They still could not get rid of those insects.
Chaos reigned in the formation of the Jinjiawei. They had all scattered. Coupled with their riding beasts rioting, the scene became even worse.
The Bi Luos, who had been hiding within the Jinjiawei’s formation, had wanted to fly in the air to avoid the disaster. However, before they had thought of lifting off, they had been pounced on by beetles with its own wings open. They were just domesticated tracking beasts, not combat-type. It would be simply too hard for them to resist when the tide of insects swept through.
The screams, the shouts of the Bi Luos, the sonorous sound of the metals clashing seemed endless. However, this battle did not last long. After a short time, some people managed to break out, but they had lost the opportunity to save the others from the tide of the encirclement. Even if the others could still hold on for a time, the pain of the bug bites meant that they would soon became food of these bugs. In a short time, they would only become skeletons.
The people who had managed to break out from the tide ignored their wounds and rushed towards Snowfield City. As long as they can reach the territory of the city, they would be much safer. However, they were out of luck. When they had just escaped from the tide of insects, they met several people who had attacked their city.
When these people met the Jinjiawei, they knew it would not be easy to fight them. But since they had encountered the Jinjiawei fleeing like a mess, the knives in their hands would be a waste if they did not take a shot.
The Snowfield King was tolerant of the time and waited for a few more days. Finally, he couldn’t ignore it and felt that the Jinjiawei were really gone.
The Jinjiawei were personally enslaved by the Snowfield King himself. If they were just ordinary ranked lower slaves, he wouldn’t care. Regardless, if those people were assassinated or had encountered an accident, he would not be interested. However, the Jinjiawei was different. Starting from his dispatch, he had been paying attention to them. Then, he had felt the connection between him and the Jinjiawei being forcibly severed by the sickle of death. Afterwards, like being smashed by a hammer, a splitting headache had suddenly punched him and he could no longer remain calm.
Surprise, panic, disbelief! The Snowfield King tried to suppress the tumbling of all kinds of emotions in his heart. He had sent a team out to find the Jinjiawei. Even if they only found the bodies, he wanted to know how those people were killed and where they died.
The people who went out followed the route the Jinjiawei used to chase Shao Xuan earlier. All the way along the path, they had not found any traces. Those who attacked the Jinjiawei had long erased their traces, not even a bone or a stone could be found. Coupled with the desert climate, wind and sand, for the Snowfield King’s men, nothing left would be found.
As they continued looking for the Jinjiawei’s team, they came upon traces that the team had encountered a swarm of insect. It was just that when they saw that, everyone felt the same feeling like being in an ice cellar.
Under the scorching sun, they only felt the chill on their backs. Their teeth were chattering hard, while they looked at the situation in front of them. They shivered, not even having the courage to go forward.
In the vast expanse of undulating yellow sand, the metal armors and some broken rags covered the skeletons, which had been half buried in the sand. The metal armors exposed outside, as well as the sharp metal weapons, glittered under the sun.
Now, let’s not talk about how the whole desert reacted to the Jinjiawei’s plight after the news spread. On the other side, under the sea, Shao Xuan had finally stopped sinking after a time.
Shao Xuan thought he was stepping on the bottom of this area, but using his special ability to view the surroundings, he realized that that was not the case. The place beneath his feet was like the top of a mountain on the bottom of the sea, going down on both sides and leading to the depths of the sea. As for what it looked like deeper, Shao Xuan has no ability and no time to look now.
It was the place beneath his feet that has a power source, pulling Shao Xuan down.
Looking around, Shao Xuan found that, although the area was not flat, it was wide.
He had been holding his breath under the sea for a long time. If this continued, he would choke to death. Therefore, Shao Xuan thought of accumulating his strength, then release it all to swim up. The sea beast above has already left. Probably because of the existence of such beast, there was no other fish activity around. There should be no other dangerous undersea creatures in this short period of time.
This was his chance to rush out!
However, as Shao Xuan accumulated his power and just intended to go upstream, the surrounding water suddenly changed.
Unlike the way when the beast appeared, the change was a massive flow of seawater, like it were going to form a whirlpool.
The sea water changed very quickly in such a short period of time. Shao Xuan simply could not escape out of it and could only follow his instinct, squatting and clinging to the rugged stone by his feet.
A whirlpool truly formed around him, but not the kind of whirlpool usually seen on the sea. It was formed vertically and the center of the whirlpool was exactly where Shao Xuan was.
The flow of water orbiting its axis showed that the underside of this rock was not in full contact with the sea floor. The rotating flow of water could then flow below.
Around him, there was a suction of everything. Shao Xuan’s body temperature was getting lower to as cold as the sea as the suction continued away. Feeling his body gradually losing its strength, Shao Xuan started to mobilize his totem power, pouring it into his body until his body temperature stabilized again to the normal range. After recovering to normal body temperature, Shao Xuan’s perception also improved.
When on land, if one freely mobilized his totem power in the mountain forest, it would be perceived by the beasts. Hence, if one wanted to hide and avoid the fierce beasts, one would not easily mobilize his totem power to the peak, unless it was the moment before a battle.
But here, Shao Xuan also originally wanted to guard against those undersea monsters. Checking his surroundings using his totem power, he thought that this site might be invaded. However, after observing more, Shao Xuan gradually realized that there was no giant beasts around, not even a small fish!!
The surrounding rips were getting bigger and bigger, and they were still rising rapidly.
Shao Xuan felt like a previous injury that has already been a scab, cracked again and blood flew from the wound, splashing and getting caught in the sea water.
His whole body was under a great pressure of being teared apart. Shao Xuan felt that his bones were going to be dislocated. He could even hear the clicking of his bones, like wood panels shaking in the midst of a storm.

chapters.title: Chapter 351
chapters.content:
C351 – At the End of the Hole
Posted on April 15, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Shao Xuan gritted his teeth to endure the feeling of dizziness caused by a lack of oxygen, as well as the pain of his bones cleaving. He could only grit his teeth to bear the pain as he tightly clung to the uneven stone surface. He knew that if he let go, he would be dragged out by the force, along with the sea, to be part of the whirlpool. In which case, he would really be dead.
Surrounded by a formation like an invisible huge net, all the creatures that touched the net would be netted in. Under the powerful tearing force around, Shao Xuan simply had no time to deal with his cracked wounds and could only mobilize his totem power to concentrate around the wound, trying to close it to reduce the blood flow.
If he didn’t have a high-level totem warrior’s physical strength, if there was not enough strength to replenish what he used, if he only have little strength to hold onto the stone, he would not be able to bear it for long.
Finally, when Shao Xuan was about to lose consciousness, everything subsided again.
Shao Xuan only felt his body turn light, then the pressure from the sea disappeared. The power tearing around also disappeared, as if it never appeared at all, so suddenly, it was gone.
His still shaking bones slowly subsided. His muscles that had been pulled taut loosened. It was not that Shao Xuan let his guard down, but that he had no more extra strength, and that he was now at his limit.
Suddenly, the changing ended and it seemed to be safe for a while, which made Shao Xuan sigh in relief.
He could exhale?
He tried to breath.
Then, breathe again.
It’s smooth!
There’s air!
Shao Xuan opened his eyes and looked around.
At this moment, Shao Xuan mistakenly thought that he had come to another world, a world without seawater.
However, after carefully distinguishing his surroundings, Shao Xuan found that he still held onto the same stone. Not far behind was still the cliffs by the sea floor. The only difference was that this place that was the sea was almost emptied. However, his clothes, the hair on his head, the little seaweed attached to the stone on the ground, were like water was sucked out of them and were now dry.
On the stone floor, the dried seaweed, which was attached to the stone floor, cracked and broke into debris as soon as it was touched.
Shao Xuan felt like he was also lacking water, hence he drank the rest of the water in his kettle. This still could not supplement his body of its missing moisture, but he just took it in a rush.
There was huge hollow that was formed around him Outside the hollow, the sea was still flowing vertically, but it no longer affected this stone land.
The surrounding was very dark. It was some distance from the sea, so they was very little light cast around. Fortunately, Shao Xuan had his other sight’s ability.
Shao Xuan sat on the stone floor, thinking about what to do next.
The feeling of lacking of oxygen was waning. Though the oxygen content here was low, Shao Xuan could withstand it, as it was still better than choking due to lack of air.
After calming down, his physical strength also gradually recovered as his mind slowly cleared.
He wanted to set out, but he didn’t know when such a change would end. Should he stay here and wait, or walk down this long hollow?
Should he do a rope divination?
But there’s no rope on his body, so should he rip a part of his clothes?
However, this time, Shao Xuan did not intend to rely on the divination since he did not know whether it would succeed. He decided to follow the words of the Shaman: when the choice is difficult, seek answers from the totem flame, when in the dark, the fire will light up the road ahead. As it was when he was trapped in the stone worm cave.
Closing his eyes, he felt the totem flame in his mind and carefully observed the movement of the flames.
At this moment, his will almost blended in with the fire.
The flames beat, drifting towards one side, once, two times…
It was no accident that when he determined the movement of the flame, Shao Xuan opened his eyes and looked ahead.
In front was the direction the flame was fluttering. Even though its end was unknown, he could never even guess his road in the future.
Looking at the swirling flow of seawater around, Shao Xuan breathed a sigh of relief and finally lifted his feet forward.
Hesitating would only be a waste of time. Now that there was a decision, he naturally has to take the time to act.
Shao Xuan didn’t know how long the hollow would last, whether it will disappear halfway through. But, since the fire has so chosen, he would give it a try. In fact, without using the tribal fire, he also has a kind of intuition to go forward.
Admittedly, it should be safest to stay here and wait for the change to disappear and for the sea to return. But Shao Xuan still intended to follow his intuition and the fire’s choice. Even if this was a dead end road, he would continue.
The surrounding was very quiet, like all the voices of the outside world was closed out. Only the sound of Shao Xuan walking was heard.
When he was hungry, Shao Xuan scraped those drained of water seaweed from the stone to eat. This seaweed was very rare that it could still tighten itself on the stone after such a large suction earlier. It didn’t taste good, but it didn’t take much for it to replenish his strength and it kept Shao Xuan from starving to death.
Shao Xuan also found that these seaweed, even if drained of water, were still well, rooted deep into the stone. If everything returned to its original scenery, the sea would cover it again, so they might continue to grow normally.
The farther forward he went, the darker the hole became. The dim light that came through from above could be seen at first, but after walking for long, there was only darkness left.
Shao Xuan did not know how long he had to walk in this dark hole, how long he had to eat those dry seaweed. Every day, in addition to resting and eating, his time was spent on running forward, afraid of the next moment the hole will return to normal and he will be buried in the sea. This ongoing pressure has been urging Shao Xuan to run, and run quickly.
Fortunately, he also had a water resource which was the rain stone given by Yang Sui. It could condense water here as this hole was only without water because of the formation of the hollow. After the change, the water could still be formed normally. Even though he knew this was not at the bottom of the sea, perhaps because it had been surrounded by water, this stone could condense water much faster than in the desert.
Shao Xuan was incredibly lucky to be carrying this stone with him, or he would die of thirst.
As Shao Xuan continued to eat the seaweed without really tasting it, he noticed that there seemed to be some dim light around.
Shao Xuan didn’t know if this was only for a short time, or he was close to the end. When he saw a mountain wall, he knew that he had reached the end.
The hole ends here and the wall was attached to the mountain.
It was just that the surroundings still looked the same.
As a last resort, Shao Xuan continued to wait again, waiting for the sea to return to its original appearance. He kept to his every day routine of eating, drinking and running, to keep his physical strength and form at its best in order to face the powerful whirlpool that might happen next.
After a while, the movement of the sea started to change.
The air was sucked away in a blink, the water vapor around him thickened and the powerful tearing force came at last.
Holding his breath, Shao Xuan had been prepared as he clung to the stone on the ground calmly.
When it was all over, Shao Xuan swam above.
Splash!
A head emerged from the surface of the sea, breathing the air together with the smell of the sea. Because he had been using his special vision in the sea most of the time, after the change, it did not take long for him to adapt to the bright world.
As he opened his eyes, the glare of the sun made Shao Xuan have a moment of deep thought. He even has a kind of feeling of not knowing what year it was.
Ahead was not a high cliff, but a piece of land.
There were high columnar cacti on the land. Some animals, similar to camels, were standing upright and biting the flowers from the columnar cactus.
A camel chewing a cactus flower, looked towards the sea, and saw the person in the water. It shook its two long ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 352
chapters.content:
C352 – New Land
Posted on April 19, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Shao Xuan swam from the sea to the shore. Since the sea has just encountered a change just then, no other creatures came to make a move on him. However, once the movement below has truly ended and a longer time has passed, there will be more sea creatures here.
Shao Xuan didn’t dare to take any chances.
After reaching land, Shao Xuan finally felt safe. In the sea, although his foot was walking on stone, he was uncomfortable because it was still in the sea. Surrounded by the sea, there was no such a sense of real land, and he was also always worried that the hole would disappear at any time. His heart has been hanging, his nerves have not relaxed.
Taking a deep breath, he observed the surrounding was with the smell of dry wind and sand, with the wind having a smell of seawater. Shao Xuan had a feeling of being reborn. This feeling made him want to let go of his voice and roar a few times. However, in such a strange place, the noise may cause some unnecessary trouble. Therefore, Shao Xuan could only hold back.
Not far from the higher ground, a few of the camel beasts chewing cactus flowers with a kind of sentient look in their eyes, raised their heads a little. Since they were on higher ground, they were able to see the lower ground where Shao Xuan was at.
They have seen humans before, but have never seen anyone appear here. Since they had not seen one here since birth, the appearance of Shao Xuan made them surprised. However, these animals, even if surprised, had the same expressions on their faces.
The surrounding ground was dry, even though it was close to the sea. The scorching temperatures coming from the surrounding sandy ground and the sparse, wilted unknown plants around him told Shao Xuan that it had not rained here for some time.
Unlike the desert at the other end of the sea, it was not pure sand in this area. Nevertheless, because of drought and prolonged weathering, there were still more fine sand.
In other words, the place was more like a mountain, just by the sea and not so high.
Perhaps, a long, long time ago, the sea level was not as high as it was now, hence, that long strip of land at both ends of the sea under the water was exposed above the sea before.
In the stone room in Snowfield City where the records were stored, the blind old slave had said that the slave owners came from the sea. They had probably passed through that narrow stone strip from this side.
Thinking of the feeling he had at the bottom of the sea, the idea of listening to the totem’s choice, Shao Xuan had a guess. Could it be that the Flaming Horns tribe that has disappeared a long time ago, also passed through that narrow stone strip from the other side of the sea and came to this land?
Shao Xuan did not feel the existence of the fire here, so he could not determine whether the other half of the Flaming Horns tribe was really on this land. However, he did not feel discouraged. In nearly a thousand years, anything could happen. In the first place, the tribe was in a crisis at that time and that other part of the Flaming Horns tribe searched for solutions because of it, but later disappeared.
Thinking of this, Shao Xuan was suddenly looking forward to the search.
After drying the water on his body, Shao Xuan drank some of the water collected in his animal skin bag. His kettle had broken down at the bottom of the sea, so he could only use the animal skin bag with the rain stone as a water bag. In order to survive, one would not worry much about it.
With some rest away from the pressure in the sea, every cell in his body seemed to carry a pleasant atmosphere. His strength was picking up quickly, hence, Shao Xuan moved and walked along the sand. He did not go far at once. In this area, he did not find any other threat like the existence of ferocious beasts. If he were to pass by this land, what he needed first was to replenish his strength quickly, not just to seek for a fight with a beast.
Speaking of which, after not eating meat for so long, as a member of the Flaming Horns who were known as a carnivorous race, Shao Xuan felt his teeth itch. Looking at the higher ground where the camel beasts were looking at him, Shao Xuan could not help but think of them all as roasted whole camels.
Shao Xuan actually wanted to wait for himself to fully recover first before solving his hunger with those camel beasts, but the other side seemed to perceive his intention. Their necks twisted and the camels ran way. Soon, even a little extra peek was not spared to Shao Xuan.
Shao Xuan: “…”
Even after seeing the camels leave, Shao Xuan did not chase after them. He waited until he had physically recovered and he had enough ability to protect himself before he set off.
It was really dry here. As he went forward, he noticed the surrounding plants, most of which were cylindrical cacti. Some of the flowers above the cactus column were just eaten by those camel beasts. Even if they were a group of animals that were used to living in arid areas, they still needed to replenish their water supply. If they didn’t see any fresh water, since they couldn’t drink from the sea, they could only nibble the flowers. Besides, the flowers on this cactus can give them the water they needed to survive temporarily.
The further he went, the more he saw those cylindrical cacti around him. They were also taller, hence, they had more flowers which the camels couldn’t reach to eat.
The surrounding was also dry. There were many areas on the ground where there were obvious cracks. The heat waves around it had likely drained all the water on the ground, constantly scraping it.
But it didn’t take long for Shao Xuan to feel the changes around him.
The wind blowing from the sea was cool, different from the heat waves on the ground. The surrounding changes cooled down the warm and humid airflow over the land, and soon, a white mist was formed.
Standing on high ground, Shao Xuan could also see some white fog grouping near the coast. The winds from the sea blew these white fog towards land.
The surrounding became foggy, quickly shrouding the area in more and more white fog. When Shao Xuan inhaled, he could also feel the obvious heaviness in the water vapor in the air.
In the surrounding plants and other areas, the fog has condensed into water droplets. On a cactus column where a slender thorn has formed, water droplets gradually condensed into a small to large, clear crystal.
Shao Xuan even saw plants with lichens attached to them. When such a fog appeared, they would absorb the water vapor in the white mist like sponges. If these plants could survive, it meant that the white mist often appeared in this place.
It was no wonder that even if the surrounding area was dry, there were some plants. It was not like the other side of the sea with the barren and desolate desert.
There were more and more animals moving around. Living in such a place, no animal wouldn’t know how to use the natural environment to survive better. The small birds flying rushed in and landed to rest on a cactus column. They drank from the cactus thorns with condensed dew.
In a place where there was very little rain but a lot of fog, the dew brought by the fog was almost a life-saving supply of all the animals that live around here.
Because of the coming animals, Shao Xuan was on guard for a moment. Later, he found that there were only small animals here, and most of them were not a threat to him. As for large beasts, Shao Xuan has not seen any for the time being.
Shao Xuan also collected some dew. He could not always rely on the rain stone. In the sea, the ability of the rain stone to condense water was very strong, but on the shore, surrounded by arid areas, that efficiency was low. Therefore, this encounter was an opportunity to collect water, so Shao Xuan naturally would not let it go.

chapters.title: Chapter 353
chapters.content:
C353 – Meeting People
Posted on April 22, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
The further he went, the less fog remained hanging around him. Although it was not too strong, it was still there. Unlike the places he’d traveled before, there were a lot more small beasts active. The atmosphere around them was not as harmless as it was before, hence, the area was full of a sense of quiet tension.
Shao Xuan tied his animal skin bag so his hand was only holding one knife. His footsteps were light, as he vigilantly moved forward.
It was at this moment that Shao Xuan heard voices.
For a long time, he did not see other people, but now, he had finally heard voices of humans. Although he knew he still had to be alert, Shao Xuan’s heart was indeed a lot relaxed. Meeting some people might not be new, but he was afraid that he was the only human in this land.
His foot shifted, turning to another direction. Shao Xuan moved towards where the voice was coming from. The fog in that area was thicker.
After listening carefully, he knew that there were two people speaking, and Shao Xuan could actually understand what those people were saying. The language here was more in favor of the language used by the slave owners. This also proved that the slave owners in the beginning may indeed have travelled from here.
Once again having proven a guess, Shao Xuan was in a better mood.
The two people also seemed to be collecting dew, as well as some plants that had absorbed the dew.
“Is that enough?” A young woman in coarse clothes looked at the man carrying a basket next to her.
Standing next to her, the young quickly watched their surroundings warily before glancing at the basket, then shook his head and said, “Let’s find some more. It hasn’t rained for a long time, and if it continued like this, it would be more difficult.”
“Ok, but remember to be careful as you looked for more.”
“I know… I’ll be careful! Back off!” The young man went up two steps and kept the woman behind him. Holding a strange knife with a long handle in his hand, he looked at something a little farther away.
Not far from them, there were some gravel slowly moving, making a subtle ‘sha sha’ sound. Beneath this, something was creeping.
Soon, the movement suddenly became larger. The other party seemed to know that it had been discovered, and there was no longer a need to hide. The ground raised a long line and something suddenly slammed. Like water vapor spewing out, the sand on the ground tumbled up to spray dust. The original cracked line along the ground revealed a long reptile.
A dark brown worm, three meters wide and ten meters long, rushed out of the ground. With its several feet and segmented body, covered in hard slices like armor, it came rushing towards the two people.
There was a sudden burst of power coming from the young man. Along with this power, some earthy stripes appeared on him. This is a totem warrior.
Like a snake, the giant worm stood up, showing the front of its body as it moved to attack the two. Seemingly aware that the man was more difficult to deal with after its two unsuccessful attacks, it shifted its target. It wobbled around the young man and opened its mouth with two sharp teeth, going towards the woman clinging onto the basket.
Although in terms of combat effectiveness, the young woman was indeed a little weaker, her skill at escaping was still good. Not having a bit of escaping ability could not make one survive long here. It was just that, under the pursuit of such a large beast, with more fog around, and with the rough ground, her speed reduced by a lot. After a slightly slip under her feet, another factor added to reduce her speed, affecting her escape.
Seeing the giant worm shifting its target, the young man became anxious. He moved his leg to run over, wanting to block it off before the giant worm attacked. If he could not block it, he could still attract its attention.
Just when the pair were getting anxious, a bang sounded. The giant worm, which was preparing to attack the young woman, was hit by an unforseen big stone.
Probably not expecting to be suddenly attacked, the giant worm took a time a time to react, unexpectedly a little stunned. It became confused of the situation. Before it could slow down to act, another stone hit. This time, the force was bigger and more violent. It was also more accurate, directly smashing into its two open jaws, that it almost turned over.
Without waiting for the giant worm to stabilize.
Ka ba!
A tooth fell from the mouth of the giant worm.
The giant worm’s other tooth, though not as miserable, was also hurt. Even if its body was hard, it still could not stand a piece of big stone smashing to it. Not to mention it had dislodged a tooth, then how would it go on?
There was no cry, but the giant worm’s movements showed it was angry. Anyone who has dislodge a tooth while catching prey could not remain calm.
Abandoning its original prey, the giant worm turned to find the source of the throw. It has already felt the location of the stone-throwing man. The average person did have limited vision in such a fog, but the giant worm was different. It could even pinpoint prey within hundreds of meters in a thicker fog.
The giant worm under a rage rushed towards Shao Xuan’s location. Originally, it thought that when the one who threw the stone saw itself coming over, it would certainly run away and it only had to exert a little to chase. However, what happened was completely different from what it thought. The stone thrower not only did not escape, but also rushed straight towards it. Based on the man’s momentum, he was not afraid at all.
Shao Xuan has not hunted for a long time since he had been at the bottom of the sea, repeatedly doing boring activities, like eating, drinking, sleeping and running. As a person from the Flaming Horns tribe, he probably has this yearning for the kind of exciting hunting life in the mountains. After disembarking on this land, he had been itching to act. When he saw those camel beasts, he almost attacked, not waiting to restore his physical strength and act early. Therefore now, with the sight of this scene in front of him, of course, he needed to take more action.
In his body, the totem power was about to explode. During this moment, Shao Xuan could even hear the powerful beating sound of his heart, like the battle drums before a fight for inspiration. His blood was rushing, and every place in his body felt like it couldn’t wait to move.
How long had he not felt this way?
After a long silence, Shao Xuan once again found that old feeling. The same feeling when the tribe was in the mountains, hunting in the forest, their blood warm, unwilling to silence the power to become ferocious, like waves tumbling to sweep over everything. Even the stomp of each step on the ground would be accompanied by a roar, like a heavy beast had slapped on the ground. Compared to the other two people, Shao Xuan’s presence was closer to a fierce beast living in the mountains.
After a full stretch, he was refreshed. Thereupon, his body contracted and the next moment, he suddenly burst out.
When the giant worm stood up again, ready to attack, Shao Xuan stomped hard on the ground, under his foot was a burst of sand. As this foot raised in the air, a lot of the fog was washed away.
The strong impact drove his body forward. Shao Xuan quickly rushed towards the giant worm, breaking open the fog as a kick went to the giant worm’s throat, where the giant worm’s tooth and two slightly longer forelegs were at, which were not usually reached by anybody else.
The giant worm actually hesitated a little in the moment before it felt Shao Xuan’s attack. But what could it want to do now that it was already too late, retreat? It couldn’t retreat now!
Even if it noticed that something was wrong, what could it do? Shao Xuan’s foot was already near, faster than the giant worm’s reactions. It was simply too late to react!
Peng!
The sound produced by the hard collisions was like a huge hammer slamming on a rock, resounding in this white fog-shrouded world.
Taking advantage of the giant worm shifting its target, the young man had taken the girl away to a distance, then looked back at the giant worm. Originally, he thought about the person who had helped them, immediately returning to fight together. However, when he turned to look, he had a shock. The worm’s body was clearly in the air, flying out…
It’s flying…
The eyelids of the two young people twitched at the same time. They even had the impulse to rub their eyes to see if the fog was too big and what they saw was an illusion.
After it landed, the striped worm’s body rolled several times along the sandy ground, smashing several cacti.
There was also the sound of a lump falling, one of which fell to the young man’s feet. When he looked at it, he saw it was the scales that fell from the giant worm, with the inner side of the shell glued with some insect skins. The scales, which protected the insect’s body as an armor, were actually kicked down that a few pieces fell!
“This this…” The young man swallowed his saliva and spit out, “Who the hell is this?”
His hand holding the knife shook, as the young thought to himself, “Even if I had my usual sword on hand to chop it, I dare not say I could break off that layer of shell. Even to draw a deep print on that shell was also difficult, but that person unexpectedly smashed the worm’s shell bare handed!” He hissed as he kept staring at the bug that has been kicked over in its belly.
After being kicked to fly and landing in a tumble, the giant worm felt that Shao Xuan was still gaining momentum. Seeing that Shao Xuan was not moving to kick it again, the worm decided to leave and take care of its injuries. It crookedly crawled in a hurry underground. In the mean time, because its throat was injured, it could not eat. Its other injuries also needed time to heal. Anyway, during these times, it decided on not coming out. It even planned on getting out of here to avoid this place.
When the worm departed, two young people who came out to collect dew looked nervously at the figure coming towards them in the fog.
Although they were grateful of the other person’s rescue, seeing that scene just now made these two nervous that their forehead were sweating. Whatever they wanted to say was stuck in their throat. Even after opening their mouths a few times, no sound came out. They also did not know what tone they should use to speak. If they irritated the other side, would the two of them also be kicked?
Shao Xuan slowly walked toward those two people. Since he had just finished a battle, the power in his body has not subsided yet. The lingering seemed to hunger for more, making the airflow surrounding his body turbulent. Even the fog around Shao Xuan was dispersing.
After running at the bottom of the sea for so long, he was uncomfortable, the physical and psychological pressure giving double impact. After Shao Xuan exerted power just now, instead of weakening his physique, his body seemed to have strengthened, becoming stronger. The leg that kicked the worm was slightly numb, but it was not uncomfortable or hurt. When he rushed out, he seemed to have known that his foot would be undamaged.
When the Shao Xuan approached, the two people finally saw what Shao Xuan looked like.
Because he hadn’t had a chance to change his clothes for a long time, what Shao Xuan was wearing had rotten into rags, revealing his body through the holes. The smooth lines of muscle were like the hardest polished stone.
If they hadn’t seen the scene with their own eyes, it would have been impossible for them to guess how terrible the power was in this man’s body.
The two stared at the appearance of the person who had kicking the worm. He’s quite young. The other person’s eyes looked back at the two of them in an easygoing and friendly way, not giving anybody a ferocious feeling.
From the outside, the two really could not think that the man could have that ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 354
chapters.content:
C354 – Born Outland
Posted on April 27, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Seeing that the other two people have remained silent, Shao Xuan decided to be the first to break the silence.
“Hello.” Shao Xuan smiled kindly at the two.
The savage and violent strength he had kicked the giant worm with had disappeared without a trace. With the words of Shao Xuan, the atmosphere had eased a lot. The tension of the young man and woman has suddenly relaxed.
“Hello… to you too.” The atmosphere eased, but when the young man opened his mouth, he was still stuttering a little. Facing Shao Xuan still made him tense, but the thought of Shao Xuan helping them made him smile, “Just, thank you. We’re from the Macca tribe, my name is Wanfu, and her name is Shuri.”
According to Wanfu, the two of them were husband and wife, just gotten married. The tribe was some distance from here, but not too far. After all, this was a remote and arid place so it didn’t have a lot tribes. Their Macca tribe was already closest to here.
Because it has not rained for a long time, the two had not saved water at home. Their family life would be difficult without water, so they came over here to look for opportunities. They did not know when the fog would appear, but to be able to collect water, they decided to wait until the fog came. They were willing to continue to wait. Fortunately, they had good luck this time. It was not two days yet when the fog came. Then, they came to a more foggy area to collect some moist edible plants, and also collect some water to take back.
“By the way, which tribe are you from?” After their own side’s introduction, Wanfu asked Shao Xuan.
“My name is Shao Xuan. As for my tribe, I don’t know where it is on this land, because I was born and raised outside and have never seen a tribe here. My parents, even grandparents, were born and raised outside.”
What Shao Xuan said was right. He was indeed born outside this land. If there really was the other part of the Flaming Horns tribe in this land, then he did not know where the tribe was and had not seen anyone else.
When they heard what Shao Xuan said, the expressions of the two as they looked at Shao Xuan suddenly changed, summing it up to one word—pitiful.
Shao Xuan: “…”
Originally, Shao Xuan was still doubtful if the two would believe even a little of this lame statement, if he were to say that he came from the other side of the sea. People who heard this were sure to feel they were being lied to. If it was someone who had never seen a tribe outside, they’d think, was he a wanderer? But, could a wanderer have such strong power? Could a wanderer jump to a senior totem warrior at once? With this nonsense, they should have asked for a better excuse.
But here it was. The two young people really believed Shao Xuan’s words, and there was no doubt showing in their faces. This really made Shao Xuan doubt if these two people were not stupid. A minimum precaution was still there, but they did not doubt Shao Xuan’s statement. That meant the situation here may not be the same as on the other side of the sea. The time when Shao Xuan saw the young warrior’s body with the totem patterns, he found that the totem color of his body was brighter. Even if it was only the grayish yellow of sand, it did not appear to be dark and had a sense of vitality. This was different from what Shao Xuan has seen before.
In the Flaming Horns tribe, except for Shao Xuan, when other people used their totem power, their body’s totem lines were dark.
There really were quite a few weird places.
“Have you ever heard of the ‘Flaming Horns’?” Shao Xuan carefully observed the reaction of the two. In this new place, if people of the Flaming Horns exist here, he wanted to know what other people think of the tribe.
When Shao Xuan had been searching for the old haunt of the tribe from the other side of the river, he had been always acting high-profile. He never hid his tribe. Because by going high profile, what the Shaman told him to pass the name of the Flaming Horns out, Shao Xuan would naturally not hide. However here, Shao Xuan has to be a little more cautious. There were too many unknowns in this land.
Wanfu and Shuri were still a little dazed about the name “Flaming Horns,” a word that was unfamiliar to them.
“Is the ‘Flaming Horns’ the tribe of your ancestors?” asked Wanfu.
Seeing the two people’s reactions defenseless and not hostile, Shao Xuan nodded. “Yes.”
After thinking about it, Wanfu scratched his head and apologized to Shao Xuan, “I think I have heard of it, but can’t remember.”
“That’s all right. I’ll look for them later.” Shao Xuan was still slightly disappointed.
When Wanfu and Shuri saw Shao Xuan like this, they felt hard for him again: Poor man!
Shuri could not help but sympathized towards this young man who had helped her and her husband. She then pulled at a corner of Wanfu’s clothes.
Wanfu realized what Shuri meant since he had the same idea himself. He said to Shao Xuan, “Do you have any plans now? Why not return with us? If not for you, we won’t be going back to the Macca tribe, so we want to show our thanks.”
Shao Xuan pondered for a moment. “Well, then I’ll be bothering you.” He did need a place to get a good understanding of this strange continent, to get more news, and to change into a complete set of clothes to use on his way.
While Shao Xuan followed, Wanfu and Shuri felt a lot relaxed. Knowing Shao Xuan’s strength, they were not too worried. There were not many threatening monsters here, and most of the time, they could solve it on their own. Otherwise, they would not have run here with just two. It was just bad luck that they met a giant worm.
With Shao Xuan chatting more, Wanfu also let go of some tension and said a lot of words.
“We came out with the rest of the tribe, but once we reached here, we scattered around. We can join them again in another area. We can’t just focus on one place. It hasn’t rained for a long time and the spring water from the mountain has also stopped. Therefore, everyone’s life is difficult, unless we go further afield to find water. We don’t want that, so we came here to try our luck.”
Shao Xuan watched as they squeezed the water absorbed by the lichen into a pottery jar. They did not throw away the lichen. After squeezing the water, he threw it inside the basket since it could be eaten.
Following Wanfu and Shuri, Shao Xuan also learned some of the ways to survive here, which things could be eaten and what couldn’t be touched.
“It would be nice if it rained, so we don’t have to run so far to find dew.” Wanfu said with emotion.
Although he spoke with emotion, he did not complain much. They had long been used to living in such an arid place. In his memory, there was even a longer dry season, but all the tribesmen had survived in the past. They just had to find a method on their own. Only those who do not want to act or were unwilling to work would die of thirst.
Seeing Wanfu and Shuri’s expressions, Shao Xuan swept his eyes to the vines next to him, entangled in a thick tree. Some branches twined among the vines had withered because of the drought of the previous days.
He pulled a string of vine off and moved it around his hands.
The two were still collecting dew, hence they did not notice Shao Xuan’s movements.
After a little while, Shao Xuan finished knotting. He looked at the result, then ripped and threw the rope away.
“After ten days, at noon, there should be rain.” Shao Xuan said.
Wanfu and Shuri paused from collecting water when they heard this sentence. They looked at Shao Xuan strangely, “You can predict the weather?”
“Only a little.” Shao Xuan didn’t say much.
Wanfu and Shuri looked at each other, not knowing whether they should believe Shao Xuan’s words. However, no matter what, they still have to collect dew now. Even if it would really rain after ten days, they also needed to survive these ten days.
After filling the jars and baskets with them, the three left and went to the place where they had an appointment with the tribesmen.
The farther they went, the thinner the mist and the hotter the air became. When one felt that scorching blast again, what you would see around you was the dry and barren land, far from how it was where the fog was shrouding the area, so full of life.
Before reaching the rendezvous site, Wanfu had hunted a beast while Shao Xuan also hunted two. Although it was not the same level as the giant worm, it has more meat than the worm. The giant worm was indeed a fierce beast, but it has not much meat, so one couldn’t eat too much. Shao Xuan, who had been eating plants for a long time, was not picky.
Of the two beasts, Shao Xuan intended to eat one for himself and the other he intended to pass later to the Macca tribe. He had intended to spend some time in the Macca tribe, so naturally he’d come with a few gifts. He couldn’t always depend on the kindness of others.
By the time the sun has skewed, Shao Xuan had also seen the rest of the Macca tribe who had come out with the couple. Several of them had been injured, but no one had died, which was already a good situation.
Wanfu introduced Shao Xuan. When they first saw him in rags, some of them had looks of disgust, but when they glimpsed the two meaty beast Shao Xuan had hunted, their faces softened a lot. Some of them also hunted some wild animals, but not as good as Shao Xuan. The amount was just not comparable.
While walking back with the Macca tribe, the other people saw Shao Xuan carrying two beasts while easily chatting with Wanfu. They did not gasp audibly, but they still couldn’t help but show shocked expressions. However, for the couple who had seen Shao Xuan take on a giant worm with a stone’s throw and kick it flying, it was not surprising.
