chapters.title: Chapter 355
chapters.content:
C355 – Is He Really a Shaman?
Posted on April 29, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
For the strong, people were always in awe. However, they also gradually backed off with slightly despising looks when they saw Shao Xuan was in ragged clothes.
As the sun approached the horizon, Shao Xuan finally saw where the Macca tribe was.
The stone wall separating the Macca tribe from the outside has a height that you could see past and the stone houses inside could be seen. Although it was not high, it was still orderly. Some homes also specially used stones to surround the yard.
Although Wanfu had brought back a stranger, the Macca tribe people did not intend to pay attention to him. However, Shao Xuan was noticeable in rags while carrying two wild animals. The impact was too contradictory. When they saw this scene, they couldn’t help but stare. Who exactly is this person? He’s weird.
On they way, Shao Xuan has learned that of the tribes here, many of whom were no longer bound by totems. They also have rituals, but most of it were just spiritual sustenance and not their main source of power. If a stranger was accepted by a certain family, as long as it did not interfere with the tribe, he could also be accepted and become a member of the tribe.
The closer he got to the Macca tribe, the deeper the doubts in Shao Xuan’s heart—he did not feel the presence of a fire seed in the Macca tribe.
When he asked about the fire pit, Shao Xuan was only told that, in the Macca tribe, they do have a fire pit. Perhaps it was a custom handed down by the ancestors. They also do rituals here, but, unlike the tribes known to Shao Xuan before, there was no fire in their fire pit.
Not only the Macca tribe, Wanfu told Shao Xuan that the rest of the tribes were the same. As for the fire seed, the ancestors would not mention it unless they tell it as a story to the younger children. But how the fire disappeared, no one could tell. A lot of it were just speculations because the stories were not clear. Nobody really knew as it happened a long time ago.
There were two old people and an elder brother living together with Wanfu. Wancha did not follow them to collect dew, but followed another team in another direction to find water. However, he only brought back some withered fruit, so it was not necessarily unproductive.
Shao Xuan temporarily lived in the Macca tribe. He spoke to Wanfu that it was only a temporary stay. He’s still going to leave in a few days.
Wancha was unlike his younger brother with a good temper. Upon seeing Shao Xuan, he also scanned him with discerning and guarded eyes as if looking at someone with bad intention. Even if Shao Xuan had brought two beasts, he didn’t change his attitude.
Shao Xuan in his ragged clothes already caused Wancha to disregard him. Then, to see Shao Xuan unexpectedly use a stone knife, Wancha had despised him even more. This man was still using a stone knife! No wonder there’s only rags that who knew how long he has worn in his person. A stone knife, tsk. That was what his grandfather’s grandfather’s grandfather had used. Although their tribe was only a little bit capable, a lot of them have metal knives. In the eyes of some people such as Wancha, Shao Xuan was a poor man with only his great strength.
Wancha also waved his somewhat deformed, scratched short sword in front of Shao Xuan. Not only the Wan brothers, majority of the Macca tribe have metal weapons on hand, or a combination of wood and animal horns with metal. Pure stone weapons were not used, with the exception of some old people.
Of course, some people thought they were smart. When they saw Shao Xuan’s extraordinary stone knife, they’d tell him, “Look at you. Let me help you.” Under the guise, they wanted to exchange their own rusty knife for Shao Xuan’s stone knife. Of course, Shao Xuan did not exchange. He just calmly look at the other person until the other became uncomfortable and took the initiative to give up and left.
Even if Shao Xuan’s eyes were calm, they had a feeling of being unable to breath while facing Shao Xuan. It’s like having a big hand covering the top of your head, which could crush you at any time.
Wanfu’s attitude has been very good. He took out his own set of intact old clothes and had Shuri slightly alter it a bit for Shao Xuan to wear. They didn’t have new clothes themselves, so they couldn’t share new ones to him.
Shao Xuan didn’t care about wearing old clothes. It was a lot better than this rags on his body.
Shao Xuan ate a large amount of food. Of the beasts he hunted, he gave one to the Wan family, the other ate himself. It only took one day to finish and he had to ran a little further out to hunt the next day. Every day, he had to go outside to hunt then return to eat one for himself, and the rest split to the Wan family.
Because of Shao Xuan’s frequent movements, some people who originally hated Shao Xuan now began to think carefully, especially the young girls of the Macca tribe. The frequency they had been walking around the door of the Wan family has increased. There were people dressed up every day, deliberately blocking Shao Xuan just to say a few words. If they found such a hunting expert, they won’t have to worry about starving for the rest of their life.
Seeing the rise in Shao Xuan’s popularity, the young people of the Macca tribe provoked Shao Xuan more. Shao Xuan adopted a strategy of ignoring them most of the time unless he could not hide quick enough. There were not many senior totem warriors in this tribe. Many among the young people were mid-level totem warriors like Wanfu, and he was not interested in bullying these people.
After understanding Shao Xuan’s strength, the number of people who challenged him gradually lessened. Instead, it was a few senior members of the Macca tribe who went to him. They were certainly open for those who were capable to stay. Knowing that Shao Xuan was only temporarily staying with them, they repeatedly sent people to persuade Shao Xuan to stay, promising some benefits. Unfortunately, they did not manage to change Shao Xuan’s minds. Because of this, they were regretting for several days.
Because Shao Xuan’s temporary residence, the living conditions of the Wan family have obviously improved a grade. The elderly and children in the family also appeared to have a lot of spirit, but the problem of water was still difficult to solve. Shao Xuan could not help them, and the rain stone in his hand was not efficient to condense water in such an arid place.
However, the water they had collected last time helped a lot and could carry on for ten days. In ten days, everything would be all right.
Seeing Shao Xuan provide meat day by day, Wanfu who still wanted to give his thanks, did not expect that they would receive too much themselves. After receiving a lot of benefits from the other, he could not help but feel guilty that Shao Xuan had not benefited a lot. He was becoming more and more guilty as Shao Xuan only asked him some things. If it was something he didn’t know, he would work hard to ask others. But this has helped Shao Xuan a lot.
On this day, Shao Xuan had been living in the Macca tribe for ten days and had a rudimentary knowledge of the place. Therefore, he did not intend to continue living here.
Walking to the door of the house, Shao Xuan looked up at the sky.
“Hey, Shao Xuan, you’re not going out today?” Wanfu just woke up and was surprised to see Shao Xuan unexpectedly did not go out.
This time of day every day, Shao Xuan has been out in the morning, waiting until the sun has skewed back. Wanfu’s family had been used to it. They also went out hunting, but would not go out every day. However, Shao Xuan was a special case. Sure enough, a real warrior was different from others.
Seeing Shao Xuan look up at the sky again, Wanfu thought of what Shao Xuan had said to them ten days ago about the rain. He also went to the door and looked up the sky.
The sun was still hanging high. There were some fluttering clouds in the sky, but in this place, sometimes, the clouds did not mean that it will rain. Looking at its shape or form was useless. Even during times when they saw clouds bringing thunder rolling, not long after, the sky would be clear again. It was not uncommon.
“I’m leaving today. Thank you for your hospitality during this time.” Shao Xuan turned and said.
“Ah? So you’re leaving?” Shuri was also surprised. During this time, she also knew about the changes in their family’s lives. Now, there was a lot of meat in the house that were not eaten yet, hanging outside the sun to dry and save up. Many people envy their home more for having such a person. Unfortunately, he was going to go. Moreover, such a person would not be trapped in a remote place like the Macca tribe. Even if he went to the city-state or go to those big tribes, he could also easily stay.
When Shao Xuan came, he did not bring much things, so when he left, he also did not bring much. The most obvious was only a change of clothes to not look embarrassing.
As Shao Xuan was leaving, he run into a Macca team that had come back from outside. The team went further afield to trade, and would help the tribesmen bring something back, like metal weapons and new clothes.
Among this long-distance team, there were three senior totem warriors, two middle-aged, their levels higher. But Shao Xuan was not afraid of them. Not mentioning that he was already leaving, he wouldn’t get to interact with this team much. It was the people in the team who saw Shao Xuan, a stranger, that glanced a few more times.
Wanfu sent Shao Xuan out of the tribe before going back.
“Wanfu, who was that man just now?” There were people in the traveling team who were familiar with him and asked.
“Oh, his name is Shao Xuan. He saved me and Shuri, then lived in our house for ten days. He’s good, he can go out hunting beasts every day!” Wanfu never hid anything about Shao Xuan when he met these familiar friends. His words also focused more on when Shao Xuan rescued them first. That situation was described in detail, while adding some words to polish it more to get the listener’s interest.
“Wow, that good?!”
“That’s right! He’s awesome!” Wanfu nodded hard. Every time he told the story, a lot of people didn’t believe it, saying it was too exaggerated. But he really didn’t exaggerate, and was telling the truth.
There were also people at the back of the line who heard all the words. They, like everyone else, felt that there were only three important points in Wanfu’s words, at best it was only five. They knew that the young people in the tribe would always exaggerate things.
However, as he heard more, the leader of the team thought about it. A spirited, hearty old man looked at the person next to him, asking, “Why do I feel that this direct move of smashing a beast with a big stone was a little familiar?”
“I think so too. I just can’t remember where I’ve heard it.” And so said the man beside the old man.
“Such a violent and insolent style of play. Indeed, I have heard of it. It should be when I went to the city-state before when I heard it.”
That was what the three highest-ranking people in the team said, so the others didn’t talk much. No matter what they thought, they won’t refute the three older ones anyway.
After a moment’s silence, the old man asked Wanfu, “What did he say to you just now when we saw him leave?”
Wanfu look at the old man awkwardly. This was the current tribal leader, and his relatives also had a very high status in the tribe and were treated respectfully.
Hearing this question, Wanfu only hesitated a little, then seriously replied, “Ten days ago, when we went out to collect water, Shao Xuan said that this afternoon, it will rain. Just now, he was reminding me that the big jars in our home full of dried meat should be washed, then wait and use it to collect water.”
When all his words finished, there were a few younger guys who didn’t hold back and laughed out loud.
“Ha! You believe that too? Who does he think he is? A wizard?”
On this side, these people do not collectively refer to such people as “Shaman”. Because of the gender, the male were called wizards, while the women were witches. Their names were not the same.
“Would a wizard be in this position? Someone who was born outside, not even knowing where his tribe is? He’s full of lies! Extremely preposterous!” Someone exclaimed.
“We should have beaten and thrown him out again.”
“And you believed that he’s such an important person, Wanfu. You’re so easy to be cheated.”
The young people kept spouting their words, but the highest-ranking people in the team remained silent. They did not speak out and seemed to be in contemplation.
After a long time, the old man smiled casually, “I’m probably thinking too much. All right, everybody, move the stuff back.”
Wanfu intended to defend Shao Xuan, but the leader of the team had spoken, so he could only swallow his defense. But when they returned, Wanfu and Shuri quickly cleared out their pots and jars that they had in the house.
Time gradually passed to noon.
The young men who returned to the tribe from the long-distance team were bragging with their tribal friends about what they had seen and heard along the outing, while the elders summed up the trip in the house.
Honglong!
Thunder seemed to tumble from a distance.
Whether it’s the young people who were bragging outside or the seniors who were talking about inside the house, they all stopped moving. The rest of the Macca tribe also stopped their work at hand and ran out to look up the sky.
The scorching sun in the sky, at this time, was rapidly being obscured by the clouds. The wind was blowing. The clouds were rapidly increasing at a speed visible to the naked eye, thickening, like an army arriving.
Honglong long—
Thunder rang in succession.
This time, its appearance was not like a trickle of rain, but a strong one really fell.
“Come on, come on! Clear the jar out of the house!” Cried someone.
“Oh no, everything in my house is loaded!”
“Take care of other stuff later and quickly clear it out!”
“What about the stuff in there?”
“Put it all out! Hurry up!!”
The weather here was changing rapidly. No one knew how long the rain would fall, hence if missed, they would certainly regret it to death.
Plop!
Plop! Plop!
The droplets of rain hit the ground and splashed a lot of dust.
The sky was no longer clear, but gloomy with horribly thick clouds.
Soon, the raindrops became dense, pouring as if someone was pouring water down from the sky.
The children screamed, barefoot and playing outside in the rain.
Then, those young people sitting at the door, bragging with their friends looked dully at the sky, murmuring, “It really unexpectedly rained down!”
The older people in the room, especially the old man, had the same idea. It was really predicted by that man!
Did this mean that man was really a wizard?!
The people who had persuaded Shao Xuan to stay before were now specially feeling remorse and regret! They knew they should not have let that man leave, even if they had to wrap their legs and arms to stop him. They also had shamans in the Macca tribe, but, among the shamans, there were high and low leveled, and their tribe’s would even be afraid to admit they were one if they went to the city-states. Their ability was too low that it would turn into a joke in the city-states. Hence, a person who could predict that it would rain in ten days would, of course, be even more powerful. If he didn’t leave…
By this time, Shao Xuan had already reached a far off distance from the Macca tribe.
In the area, the cactus around were desperately absorbing the water underground with their roots because of this rain. Their stems were deeply sunken with crease-like folds, but because of their water absorption, it had inflated a lot. They were like a machine that continuously stored water. The water saved up would then make them ready to spend the next dry day.
Shao Xuan walked under the downpour, wiping the water on his face. He looked at the thunder and lightning up in the sky, smiling softly as he continued his journey forward step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 356
chapters.content:
C356 – Strange Old Man
Posted on May 4, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
After leaving the Macca tribe, Shao Xuan also saw other tribes who were out, but he did not join them. Those people were more guarded against Shao Xuan, presumably because they were carrying some goods which they were worried that Shao Xuan would steal.
Shao Xuan has experience traveling. He knew that in the middle of an encounter with strangers, the team would choose to avoid, so he did not go up to them. He stopped at a distance of twenty meters to ask them.
The other side saw Shao Xuan did not come close, so they reluctantly answered his two questions, but then hurried away.
Shao Xuan just asked about the geographical structure of the surrounding area, but the other side’s answer was too brief. Shao Xuan could only relate it to the information he got from the Macca tribe to speculate of the place he should go to.
Here, there were tribes that were also under the jurisdiction of slave owners, but tribesmen and slave owners did not have much contradictory relations. Not like on the other side of the sea where there was always conflict. It was even common for many tribesmen to often trade in the cities under the jurisdiction of the slave owners. The Macca tribe, for example, often has a traveling team to the nearest city, exchanging things for clothes, copper weapons and so on.
Shao Xuan, however, had no intention of going around the slave owners’ turf. What he most wanted to know now was whether the other half of the Flaming Horns tribe was here or not.
If those people’s preferences have not changed, they would probably be more inclined to reside in the forest area, a place where there were especially many fierce beasts. If they went to a place with a lot of people, the animals and beasts would naturally become less, so Shao Xuan planned to go to the mountains where there were fewer people to try his luck.
After asking about the surrounding land structure, Shao Xuan used rope divination once again to determine the position and went to that area. He just got a rough direction, and did not know the exact distance, so he only went straight.
At first, he could see some people in a distance for two days, but gradually, he saw a lot less. The land became desolate. The surrounding mountains widened. He did not know if it was because of the soil, but the growing plants were not lush, and even the stout trees were not much.
When Shao Xuan looked up, he saw the surroundings undulating slightly with desolate mountains, cascading up and down. He did not change course, intending to pass between the valleys, while listening carefully to the movements around him tht were not from the cries of some birds and small beasts. He did not hear other dangerous noises. The birds and beasts cry were more peaceful, and there was no fear in them. The area, relatively speaking, should be counted as safe.
There were the occasional streams flowing through the valley. Shao Xuan had been walking along a set route and direction. When he walked to a stream, he saw someone lying at the water’s edge, his head resting beside the stream while the stream was flowing by. As he rushed to the person’s side, he saw the man’s gray hair unbound in the stream, scattering in the water.
If the other side was already dead, Shao Xuan would not be able to do anything. However, the person was still breathing, albeit a little faint.
After a while, Shao Xuan found that it was an old man with a lot of wrinkles on his face, a little older than how he looked from the back. The person did not have any serious trauma, except for a bone fracture on his right arm. All his other body parts were fine.
The man’s clothes had gone gray and he did not know how much it had been through. The clothes were ragged, only a little bit better than when Shao Xuan first arrived. But the man had several bronze knives. They looked different and were very small, the shape not looking like these were used as a hidden weapon, so he did not know what it’s for. The old man also had a bag wrapped around his waist. The bag was made of animal skins, the leather from a high-level beast, since the skin of an ordinary beast would not be so strong.
After careful scrutiny, Shao Xuan slowly turned the man over and moved him away from the stream.
Calling out also would not wake him, as well as tapping him awake. Seeing that the person would not wake up, Shao Xuan’s vision fell on the animal skin bag on the side at the man’s waist. He reached out to poke it a bit. When the man was lying at the edge of the stream, his uninjured left arm has been protecting it, even when he was turned over, his arm did not leave it. This was an unconscious behavior, indicating that for this person, this skin bag was important.
When Shao Xuan reached for the animal bag and poked it, the person did not wake up, but his muscles on his face twitched.
After poking it again, the man jerked open his eyes. Eyes full of blood, guarded and murderous. He propped himself on the ground with his elbow, quickly moving away from Shao Xuan as he did two rolls. Then, his head hit a big stone on the side, and Shao Xuan listened to the sound of his pain. Why are you so excited?
Fortunately, the man had finally regained consciousness. After a few grunts of pain, the person moved to reach out and touch his hit forehead, but the injury on his right arm hurt. He then moved his left arm that had been protecting the animal skin bag, but after thinking, put it back in its original position to continue to protect the animal skin bag. He let the blood flow on his forehead, as his eyes stared at Shao Xuan, afraid that Shao Xuan would come near.
“Don’t worry, I won’t rob you.” When Shao Xuan saw him like this, he reassured the other man.
At such an old age, without knowing why he fainted by the stream near the water, to just wake up and hit his head on a stone, he had to be feeling strange.
The other man’s posture relaxed a little, but his guard on the bag was still up.
“If I wanted to, I would have robbed you earlier, so why would I wait till now? Besides, even if I wanted to rob you now, can you stop me?” Shao Xuan said.
That’s right. The vigilance on gray-haired old man’s eyes withdrew somewhat. He had just woken up when he felt murderous and retreated, so his brain was still a bit dizzy. Gradually, he got his bearings and finally asked Shao Xuan, “You have meat on you?”
It was a question, but his tone sounded certain.
Shao Xuan reached out and pulled a piece of dried meat out of his bag and threw it over, asking, “How did you faint here?”
The old man hurriedly caught the dried meat Shao Xuan threw over. After smelling it, his eyes showed a little aversion, but his actions did not slow down, quickly taking a few bites while stuttering an inarticulate answer to Shao Xuan question, “Hungry.”
Shao Xuan had first thought it was poisoning or any similar reason. He did not expect the answer was unexpectedly because the man fainted due to hunger.
Quickly, the meat Shao Xuan gave was finished and the old man looked at Shao Xuan again. ” Is there more?”
Shao Xuan pulled out another piece, but did not immediately hand it over, instead asked, “You answer a few questions of mine first, then I will give you the meat in my hand.”
The old man frowned but did not speak. He didn’t look happy.
However, Shao Xuan did not care. He raised his hand and pointed in a direction. “If I go that way, how long would I be able to see a denser forest?”
After hearing Shao Xuan’s question, the old man’s frowning brow loosened. He thought it was going to be a problem, but it turned out to only be this.
“I don’t know, I haven’t been there. I’m here for the first time. However, as far as I know, it’s impossible for you to see a denser forest in at least two days. It’s always the same here,” the old man replied, “This is a famous wasteland. There isn’t even a tribe. You will not see anyone else in two more days if you go there.”
After handing the meat to the old man, Shao Xuan went to the stream to wash his face, then continued on his way. The old man ate the meat and finally regained his spirit. He could also go, but did not have to follow Shao Xuan and meddle with each other’s business.
But when Shao Xuan hadn’t even taken a few steps, the old man’s voice came from behind him.
“Hey, wait a minute! That little brother!”
First, he was guarded against a thief, but now, it’s “little brother” like they were close. The man must have some other intentions when he became so affectionate.
Shao Xuan turned around, his eyes asking the other what’s the matter
The old man climbed up from the ground, looked around, his eyes finally resting in one place. He happily pointed in a direction. “There! That grass with white stripes, you pluck it off for me.”
Listening to this tone, you’d know it was a command, especially with the posture of the person. He took another look at the place the old man was referring to. At almost 90 degrees above ground on the mountain, at least 30 meters high from the ground, there were several half-arm long grass with white stripes growing.
Shao Xuan wanted to turn around when the other man did not seem to realize his tone was not right. Then, Shao Xuan thought about it, and chose to ignore the old man and his tone. Besides, he also wanted to know what those grass with white stripes do anyway.
In such a new and strange place, it was always good to know more.

chapters.title: Chapter 357
chapters.content:
C357 – Thousand Gold Grains
Posted on May 6, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Although the mountain wall was almost perpendicular to the ground that, for many people, it would be difficult to climb, for Shao Xuan, it was nothing. After all, he had been doing this kind of climb up a mountain often in the tribe when hunting, so he was experienced.
The old man stood below, watching Shao Xuan leap from the ground. He cleverly crawled from below up the mountain wall like a gecko sticking to the wall, looking comfortable and not struggling at all. Seeing this scene, the old man could not help but raise his gray eyebrows, staring at the back of Shao Xuan with burning eyes.
Shao Xuan, who was crawling up the mountain wall, sensed something. He stopped and turned back to look at the old man below.
The old man smiled oddly, then waved his hand at Shao Xuan, pointing to the grass on the mountain wall. “Go on, continue.”
Shao Xuan suppressed his questions and continued to climb up. Then, he reached out to the grass to pluck it, intending to directly pull it down.
“Hey! Don’t pull it, don’t pull! Dig the roots. With the roots it can last longer. Just dig with my knife, then!” The old man pulled a strange bronze knife out of his leather bag, then threw it over to Shao Xuan.
It’s a lot of crap. Shao Xuan abdomen.
[E/N: Don’t get this. (?_-;)…]
The throw was accurate. Shao Xuan left his one hand clasped on the wall of the mountain, while the other hand caught the knife. Then, with the knife, he dug out the white striped grass.
The knife looked strange, but very suitable for digging this kind of grass growing on the wall of the mountain. It was not long before the grass root was dug out.
“Done.” Shao Xuan threw the knife and grass down.
The old man hurried over, ignoring the falling knife, and carefully caught the fallen grass.
“What do you use this grass for?” Shao Xuan came down from the wall of the mountain and saw the old man cut down a piece of grass and put it in his mouth.
“Medicine, useful for bone injuries.” The old man did not say much, just kept vigorously chewing on the leaves, the muscles on his face twitching. After chewing and swallowing it, he felt that it was not enough, so he cut down a smaller leaf, then kept chewing.
Remembering the old man’s bone injury on his arm, Shao Xuan stared at the grass. He also saw the old man chewing on the grass changing his expression like his pain was lessening. Shao Xuan asked, “How does it taste?”
The old man didn’t say much, just cut off a small leaf and handed it to Shao Xuan. “Taste it?”
“Can I eat it without an injury?”
“You can as long as you don’t eat a lot. It’s okay.”
“Then, I will.” Shao Xuan took the leaves. When he had dug it out, he did not look closely, so only now did he find that the veins of the grass looked flexible. However, it was harder than he imagined, especially the parts with the thickest white stripes or veins. It seemed like a hard snap could have it make a crisp sound.
After taking a bite of the leaf’s tip first, Shao Xuan felt a cool bitter taste but did not find any side effect in his body. Then, he bit half a leaf, chewing it all up. This time, after eating the more veiny parts, the rich bitterness offset the cool taste down.
No wonder the old man’s face muscles were twitching like it was bitter.
The old man also wanted to see Shao Xuan’s bitter face, but found that Shao Xuan just wrinkled into a frown. There was no other expression.
Did it not taste good? Thought the old man. If so, then this young man is so pathetic that he can’t taste the taste of the world.
Ignoring the old man’s thoughts, Shao Xuan ate the whole leaf after chewing. The bitter taste gradually faded away, but the cool feeling remained. His exhaustion lessened a lot, but as for his bones, since he had no bone injuries, the changes in Shao Xuan was not obvious. He just felt that there seemed to be some power flowing into his bones.
Now that the old man was all right, Shao Xuan turned to leave. This time, Shao Xuan just moved, but the old man hurriedly stopped him.
“Hey, wait. You’re going that way? I’ll come with you.” The old man straightened up and put the white striped grass carefully inside a skin bag.
Shao Xuan turned to look at the old man. He didn’t say anything, waiting for the old man to follow up his words.
“I’m here to find something too. Although I’m not familiar with the area, I know more than you do. Don’t think that the area is desolate, there’s a lot of poisonous plants here. If anything happens to you, I can help,” said the old man.
“What else?” Shao Xuan waited.
“If it’s not inconvenient for you, if I find anything, you can help me get it.” The old man thought it was a really good idea, “Ok, that’s it.”
Shao Xuan ignored him and went on along his planned route.
The old man quickly kept up, continuing to persuade Shao Xuan.
When the old man’s spit was almost dry, Shao Xuan asked, “What are you looking for here?”
“I’m looking for…” The old man suddenly cut off his words. He seemed a little reluctant and didn’t not want to say it.
“Then, forget it.”
Seeing Shao Xuan continue forward, the old man followed, sighing, “Have you ever heard of ‘thousand gold grains’?”
Thousand gold grains?
The name had “gold”, but it certainly did not refer to gold, the metal. Since the old man came here, and seeing his actions, he should be looking for a plant? Since the name was with the word “gold”, it either referred to its color or it was used to highlight its value.
After thinking, Shao Xuan shook his head. “Never heard of it.”
The old man looked at Shao Xuan with an expression thinking he was really ignorant. “I came to this place just to find ‘thousand gold grains’. According to reports, it’s a plant that produces thousands of grains and is drought-tolerant and can grow in barren places where rainwater is scarce.”
Food crops?
“So you came here to try your luck?” Shao Xuan asked. This place was really barren too, although there was a stream in the mountains. However, this place looked like it did not experience much rain.
“Yes, we grow crops in my land, but there was little rain in these two years, and I heard that the drought will last for several years.” As he was speaking, the old man was extremely emotional. But complaining was useless, so he came looking for these drought-tolerant food crops.
“Don’t you have a witch or a wizard? Can’t they call for rain?” Shao Xuan asked again. He didn’t know if this side has tribes that could ask for rain, so he was probing. In this place, in addition to some tribe’s shaman, there were some independent full-time shamans that many people would pay some remuneration to to please. Thereupon, they would help solve some of the people’s problems they couldn’t solve themselves.
As the old man listened, he showed an angry face. “Forget that bunch of crap! Saying their family were descendants of ancient sorcerers, but they couldn’t even beg for the rain to come down, useless!”
Shao Xuan: “…”
He dared to call the shamans “useless”. So far, this was the first time Shao Xuan had heard such, and it was in an angry tirade. Even the people of the Macca tribe would be absolutely afraid to say that shamans were useless. Of the people he had encountered, majority of them even held shamans in a kind of awe-inspiring mindset. Except for the one next to him.
If they couldn’t solve the problem of rain, they could only work on the crops. No matter what the old man’s temper was, trekking for a thousand miles trek in order to find a solution was admirable.
“That ‘thousand gold grains’, what does it look like?” Shao Xuan asked.
“It’s the thousand gold grains! Of course, I haven’t seen it with my own eyes.”
“Never seen it, then how will you find it?”
“I can recognize it when I see it.” The old man didn’t think there was anything wrong with it at all.
“By the way, what’s your name?” asked the old man.
“Shao Xuan, and you old man?”
“My name is Ju.” The old man also wrote the word on the ground with a branch as he introduced himself.
The old man did not ask which tribe Shao Xuan was from. He was not interested in which tribe he came from.
Shao Xuan was ready to ask again, wanting to inquire about the Flaming Horns tribe from the old man, but the old man suddenly spoke. “That, Shao something, get that for me too.”
“I won’t. I’m not your slave.” Shao Xuan also did not turn back, instead walked forward.
Seeing that Shao Xuan had already gone far, the old man finally realized the tone he was using. He hurriedly went to slow down and pull Shao Xuan. “Please help me. Take that one for me too.”

chapters.title: Chapter 358
chapters.content:
C358 – Eating Poisonous Plants
Posted on May 10, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Shao Xuan never expected that this old man could get rid of his commanding tone. On most days, he was probably used to call on people and could not change the habit immediately. Being made to say a word of “please/help” should be rare.
Seeing the old man excitedly pointing at something, Shao Xuan turned to the direction he was referring to.
Another kind of grass was on the wall, but this grass looked very ordinary. It has no pattern, like the grass just under Shao Xuan’s feet, however, the leaves were slightly narrower and a little longer.
“What kind of grass is that, what’s its use?” Shao Xuan asked.
“I don’t know.”
Shao Xuan: “…You don’t know then what are you so excited about.”
“Of course it’ll make me excited! I’ve never seen that kind of grass before.” The old man stared straight at the mountain wall, urging Shao Xuan, “Hurry!”
Shao Xuan shook his head, deciding not to follow the old man command to hurry. However, the uphill climb to where the grass was only took a moment to reach for Shao Xuan. There was not much difficulty and Shao Xuan never encountered problems along the way. Same as before, Shao Xuan used the old man’s knife to dig down the grass to its roots, then threw it to the old man afterwards.
Except for some of the herbs often used in the tribe, as well as the recorded plants, Shao Xuan was not familiar with many other plants. Especially on this side of the sea, he did not know most of the plants. Shao Xuan could not tell what was special with this grass, so he wanted to see how the old man treated it.
He saw the old man give it a careful observation, then smelled it. He cut off a leaf afterwards, then bit a little at the leaf’s tip, and carefully tasted it.
“How does it taste?” Shao Xuan asked.
The old man shook his head. “No taste. It’s very strange, not even the usual taste of grass.”
“What else do you think?” Shao Xuan asked again.
“I have an idea. There’s this kind of… a bad feeling.” The old man commented.
You felt something bad about it, but you still kept eating?
Shao Xuan saw the old man ate a whole leaf, then the old man’s face began to twitch. It was not one of suffering, but his muscles were really having uncontrollable convulsions. His complexion also turned into a bizarre blue gray.
Poisonous!
“SPIT IT OUT!” Shao Xuan hastened him. Looking around, he took down a branch and peeled off its outer skin. He’s going to make the old man vomit.
The old man, who was quickly turning gray, saw Shao Xuan with a branch, going for his throat. He knew what the other was planning to do, so he turned his head to avoid the outstretched branch. He raised an arm to block Shao Xuan. “Nn.. go.. I-I’m okay!”
Shao Xuan took a moment to react. The old man was blocking him and moving away.
All right, I’ll go and walk away. Shao Xuan thought: I’m not the one who’s poisoned. I’m not feeling anxious.
He thought the old man would spit it out on his own or take out some herb he had hidden to detoxify it. However, the old man’s actions just made Shao Xuan surprised.
The old man’s gray a face wrinkled deeper because of the pain. The muscles on his whole face looked squished together, looking like it was very uncomfortable. After stumbling for two paces, the old man sat down against the wall of the mountain.
“Hey, old Ju, are you really all right? Shouldn’t you eat something to detoxify it?” Shao Xuan advised.
The old man did not speak. He only laid down his hands softly and sat there motionless. He did not speak, only closed his eyes. If not for the slight ups and downs of his chest, at first glance, it would really make people think he’s dead.
His breath was getting weaker.
Shao Xuan stared at the old man, thinking, is this old man going to die?
He had not seen him eat anything or vomit. He just continued to choke on the poison. Did this mean he was going to die? But wasn’t it taking too long?
Suddenly, Shao Xuan saw some black stripes appearing on the old man’s body, like leaves extending towards his face and arms. On the exposed skin outside his clothes, there appeared a black tattoo all over his body.
Totem patterns?
There was a fire in Shao Xuan’s mind. This fire was the source of strength within the old man’s body. The difference was that there was a vague shadow in the fire, like a grass or something, that he could not see clearly as it was surrounded by the fire.
Blue and red flames intertwined, far from appearing weak, but burning more and more. The flames swelled and expanded. The faint shadow within the fire, as if a weak seedling, rose and grew.
Looking at the old man’s tattoo, he saw that the original black tattoo gradually turned into a bright green. The old man’s gray face also began to subside. The dead air was expelled, replaced by a very strong breath of life.
When the grayness of the old man’s face completely disappeared, the green tattoo also faded. Everything once again became his usual appearance. By just looking at the old man’s appearance now, no one would think that the old man just ate a piece of poisonous grass and was almost poisoned. If Shao Xuan had not seen it with his own eyes, he never would have believed it.
No wonder he wasn’t afraid, and even so vigorously pushed him away. He actually has an ability to save himself, so Shao Xuan finally calmed down.
The old man released a long breath, then opened his eyes. He took a closer look at the seemingly inconspicuous grass that was still in his hand with bright eyes.
Seeing the old man carefully put the grass away, Shao Xuan asked, “You are really all right?”
“I’m all right. What’s a little poison.” The old man really didn’t care. His tone was light and he never took the usually dangerous situation to heart.
That was how the old man was. If it was someone else, he would be poisoned and die.
“From the foot of the mountains to the present, I have tasted more than a hundred kinds of grass. There’s also poisonous grass, and this strain is not even the most poisonous.” The old man said casually.
Getting a glimpse of the old man’s eyes flashing with pride, Shao Xuan who wanted to say something, stopped himself.
The old man thought Shao Xuan would be amazed. He waited and waited but when he looked up, the old man found that Shao Xuan had already stepped forward and left. He knew he needed his help, so he hurriedly chased him. He still expected Shao Xuan to help him get the grasses. In his travel before meeting Shao Xuan, he also saw a lot of strange grass, but he couldn’t get them himself and even broke an arm at one time. He could only give up then. But it’s different now, having someone to help him pick the grass was a great benefit.
Because of the old man’s concerns, Shao Xuan did not follow the shortest route. Sometimes, he would go over a mountain to find some plants, but the general direction has not changed, though the distance became farther away.
Shao Xuan followed the old man, collecting some poisonous plants and herbs, encountering a lot of plants. It was rare for him to encounter a person who would listen to his ramblings, so the old man did not concern himself with the time. He would also talk about the locations of various herbs and other places he knew of more.
From the old man’s words, Shao Xuan did not only learn a variety of medicinal plants, but also some tribes and the locations of the cities. On the whole, this trip was still worth it.
The old man told Shao Xuan that one could judge something from the direction of some flying insects, such as what changes were taking place in the plants there. The insects have different preferences, so they would save a lot of time if they looked for those.
“Of course, in addition to these flying bugs, we could also look for some other beasts, such as…” The old man was going to point to a small bird, ready to continue his speech, when his ear quickly shook. The old man’s eyes flashed, ignoring the bird, and looked at another place. At the same time, his hand signaled Shao Xuan not to make a noise.
Shao Xuan saw that there was a cluster of low grass, which was the densest grass around, where the old man was looking.
Behind this grass, there was an animal hidden, similar to a mouse with gray fur. It listened carefully to the movement in its surroundings and only poked out its head after a time to sniff the air. Then, in a flash, it jumped out and ran.
“Come on, follow it!” The old man suppressed his excitement and whispered to Shao Xuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 359
chapters.content:
C359 – Taste Test
Posted on May 13, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
For this mountain wild rat to make the old man so excited, was it perhaps related to what the old man called the “thousand gold grains”?
Shao Xuan did not stay idle for long, briskly keeping up with that wild rat.
The wild rat ran fast, but it stopped at times. Whenever it paused, it looked around with vigilance, then continued to run if it found no threat around.
Shao Xuan could only use some low trees or slightly higher grass for cover since the plants in this area were sparse so he could not find a lot of obstructions. Therefore, quietly keeping up with the wild rat was a little difficult.
For Shao Xuan, even if the difficulty was big, he could still overcome it and could successfully keep up with that wild rat, but that was not the same with the old man. His skill in hiding was not as good as Shao Xuan, so he could only remain a little farther away as he followed. Fortunately, he did not have to keep his eye on that wild rat. He only had to follow Shao Xuan.
After about twenty minutes, the wild rat finally stopped. Shao Xuan stood from somewhere nearby, watching the wild rat eating the food it found. He turned behind him to look at the old man and signal to him with a wave of his hand.
Even if Shao Xuan did not know that plant, he was still sure that that was not what the old man was looking for, the “thousand gold grains”. It was only a nearly metre high shrub, with a number of small fingernail-sized red fruits above. The wild rat’s goal was those red fruits.
After seeing the wild rat eating the fruit, the old man squinted his eyes, then sighed. “It’s a pity.”
However, the old man never held too much hope. He knew that the thousand gold grains was not easy to find, so he had prepared himself early on.
After it finished its food, the wild rat slowly moved in the other direction, still running, but not as fast as before.
There were some birds in the sky that were smaller than sparrows flying over to take a peck at the fruit.
The old man grabbed the fruit and hid it before the birds pecked it all, then threw it into his mouth.
There was a raised stone on the ground next to the plant, so the old man sat there, eating the fruit while looking around the forest.
“Do you know this plant?” Shao Xuan asked.
“I don’t know. I’m eating it for the first time,” replied the old man.
Shao Xuan frowned but reached out and took a few fruits from the low shrub and threw them into his mouth. It was a little sweet, but the taste was ok. No wonder the wild rat hurriedly rushed this way.
When hunting in the mountains, if they see a plant they didn’t know, even if the fruit looked delicious, the hunting warriors wouldn’t touch it. Unless they had seem other animals had eaten it. They’d try a little bit of it, then determine if they could be used into their meals. But the old man who obviously had an ability to detoxify, was unbridled and blindly ate it. However, Shao Xuan believed that even if he had not seen the scene of the wild rat and birds eating it, the old man would still do the same.
“Old Ju, why is it that you wanted to try all kinds of plants and fruits? Just to test if it’s poisonous with your body?” Shao Xuan asked.
“Yes, whether it’s poisonous or a beneficial drug, it needs to be tried before you know. There’s a lot to be found in the future. We…… my family, since the time of our ancestors, began it by countless attempts. We eat anything, and through taste testing, we can obtain a lot. Knives, basket, bed, bedding, pillow, tea, wine, vinegar, sugar, oil, which one an ancestor has not tried out first?” The old man said with his eyes having an incomparable color of reverence. He did not even had that emotion while eating the fruit. “My generation and its descendants will also inherit the will of our ancestors and lead a glorious future! We’ll be the glory of all ages!”
Shao Xuan looked at the old man speaking with his spit flying, full of enthusiasm. This was really someone worshiping his ancestors. The old man’s greatest goal today was to find the thousand gold grains that was once mentioned in an ancestor’s notes before dying.
“Even if I could only have a glimpse of it, I’ll be satisfied,” said the old man.
Since he had read it mentioned in an ancestor’s note, the old man couldn’t sleep without thinking about it. Especially now that in many places, there was drought and food crop harvest was poor. Not everyone was willing to hunt these days, and many people with little abilities and were used to more comfort were used to farming in the fields. Not many people would like to go to the distant mountains to fight with the beasts. Moreover, the areas now with many people gathered around did not have many beasts. Even if they wanted to hunt, they had to run further afield. Furthermore, the lush mountains have been overrun by some fierce tribes. Those who were not willing to talk it out would start a discord, especially those horns guys.
Hence, if they could find more drought-resistant food crops, they would be able to ease their current problems to some extent. As for Shao Xuan’s thought on rain, there were people who had been asking for it every year, but it’s a pity that it had not been answered. He gets angry whenever this old man thought of it. Those people who called themselves descendants of ancient shamans, only collected the money quickly, but found excuses to not immediately pray for rain. They’re simply a group of waste!
After a break, the pair continued along the big route, only occasionally slipping up a hill midway through.
Two days later, even the shadow of the thousand gold grains was still not found.
In these two days, because he had been touching strange plants and eating them, the old man became poisoned again for four times, one of which even made him bleed profusely. It was very frightening. Shao Xuan thought that the old man would have difficulties getting through, but the only result was that the old man was tired for half a day. Afterwards, he became lively and continued to find the thousand gold grains.
In this regard, Shao Xuan only had a sigh at the toughness of the old man’s inherited detoxification ability.
A lot of times, Shao Xuan only listened to the old man, occasionally saying a few sentences, but most of the time, he was just a listener. From the old man’s words, Shao Xuan speculated about something. Perhaps the old man did not come from a tribe, but from the city under the jurisdiction of a slave owner. He’s likely a slave owner himself.
It was the first time Shao Xuan had seen such a slave owner. He previously only had the impression of a slave owner in the deserts on the other side, and never encountered an alternative kind.
“Then, I’ll take a break first, and you look around.” The old man sat down against the mountain wall using a stick. “This man is old and couldn’t get younger anymore so I will rest first.”
“You don’t have to worry about me. Quickly sleep, take a break.” Shao Xuan said.
Because he was with this old man, Shao Xuan’s pace had slowed down a lot, and they were not walking the shortest route. After walking for two days, he had not seen any changes around the little dense forest. He did not know how long they had to walk at such a speed to see a little thickening of the forest.
Since he had agreed to go with the old man, Shao Xuan would not leave him behind halfway. He was fine slowing down since he was not particularly in a hurry.
In this barren place, Shao Xuan had not seen a large beast up to now, but saw a few human skeletons.
Sweeping his eyes around, Shao Xuan recalled the day when the old man introduced to him several useful plants. As he swept his eyes, Shao Xuan silently reviewed the old man’s teachings, brushing up on what he learned again.
As he was thinking, Shao Xuan heard a sound of running. The sound was not big, but as he listened to the sound and rhythm, he thought it was a lot like the wild rat he followed before.
If it was just one before, Shao Xuan heard a few more moving now.
Was this wild rats’ nest near?
Shao Xuan got up and looked over to the place where the sound came from.
A few wild rats came from different directions, running in the same direction. It was not like they were running for their lives, but more like the wild rat previously searching for fruit, with eagerness and longing.
“Old Ju! Hey, wake up, old man, we have a situation!” Shao Xuan pushed the old man, who was still asleep.
“What’s the matter?” Because Shao Xuan was there to guard, the old man had a rarely peaceful sleep. Before he had slept enough, he was woken up by Shao Xuan, so he was a little confused for a moment.
Shao Xuan was about to talk about his discovery to the old man, but before he could open his mouth again, the old man’s ears shook as he heard the movement around. It was a complete professional change. If he heard other noises, he would skip it directly. Only a few specific sounds could stimulate his nerves in the shortest possible time.
After a shiver, the old man excitedly got up and looked around. He threw the stick he used as a crutch, then climbed the small mountain’s side.
There’s no view here, so he was going to a higher point to look. However, there were no tall and thick trees around, so he looked around the terrain, and thought that the most time saving thing to do was to climb the wall.
“Hey, you should slow down.” Shao Xuan was afraid that his foot would slip so he guarded below. If the old man had fallen from above from his excitement, he would still be able to move on.
However, even if the old man was really emotional and too excited that he could not help himself, he still managed to single-mindedly climb. Shao Xuan saw him climb hard, but still waited to extend a hand if needed.
After climbing up, the old man’s radar-like eyes swept around, sweeping his hearing while looking around, presumably distinguishing the desired sound from the rest of the murmur around him.
The old man’s craziness seemed logical.
