chapters.title: Chapter 360
chapters.content:
C360 – Group of Wild Rats
Posted on May 17, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
After climbing down the wall, the old man’s hands and feet were shaking but not because he was afraid, he was actually excited.
He thought the other man would be too slow to climb down, but he directly jumped down beside Shao Xuan, not even waiting for Shao Xuan to say anything and just ran after jumping down.
“I…” Shao Xuan wanted to say something but did not have time to say it. He hurriedly moved to catch up.
“This is it! Definitely!!” When the old man came down, he hurried in one direction. That was where the wild rats ran past.
“Even if it’s not the ‘thousand gold grains’, it’s certainly something strange to make these wild rats behave like this!” The old man kept running. Even though he hadn’t gotten enough sleep, he had a lot of spirit. This time, he was full of strength and could keep up.
Shao Xuan also wondered what really led the wild rats to be this crazy. As he ran forward, there were some wild rats that sprang up from elsewhere. Upon seeing Shao Xuan, those wild rats only briefly paused, then continue to run. It seemed that compared to Shao Xuan, this strange creature, another thing was more interesting to them, so they ignored Shao Xuan’s existence and single-mindedly moved on.
“There hasn’t been so much wild rats running before, why did it suddenly increase?” Shao Xuan wondered.
“It must be the fruit is getting ripe!” The old man didn’t say much, just sped up again on his feet. After waiting so long, looking for so many years, once again, he could see hope. Although he had encountered a similar situation before and it was not the thousand gold grains but another precious herb, this time, he had a strong hunch. The ancestor’s note had also mentioned when he found the thousand gold grains, that he had seen weird rodent activities around, but the note recorded too few things. The old man could not get more information from it, and could only look for it on his own again and again.
This time, it must be it! For sure! The old man was roaring in his heart.
From what Shao Xuan knew of the old man now, although it had only been a few days, it was the first time he had seen him running so fast, his eyes filled with fanaticism. If there was anyone to try to stop him, the old man would probably fight them desperately.
The more they ran, the more wild rats they met. The small animals that live near, whether they were hiding in their caves or hidden underground would come out and ran out, catching up to them and going towards the same place they were running to, like they got a boost of energy.
The movement around them also attracted some other animals. Those animals were actually aiming for the wild rats.
A ferret-like animal intercepted several wild rats, then flashed past with its prey in its mouth. There was also a seemingly stupid ferret actually crossing, as if it wanted to stand as a block, but those wild rats, with their unimaginable energy, did not slow down. They did not even change direction, and just rushed over to jump a foot over the ferret. The latter few did the same thing. If it were their usual, these wild rats would certainly not have the guts. When they saw the threat, they would definitely ran far away.
Then, if they saw the same of their kind being taken away, they would not give it an extra look and would not stay a second.
However, as they got closer and closer to the target, their numbers were growing. The robbing animals were much less, probably seeing such a situation and did not dare single-handedly come to hunt or they’d be the ones bitten.
Shao Xuan and the old man followed these wild rats. When they came near the top of the mountain, they were forced to stop.
Why did they suddenly stop?
They had to stop since they could only go that far. The area forward were all occupied by the wild rats. Meanwhile, the wild rats, who had rushed from another direction, joined this large team.
Although this scale was not comparable to that time in the desert when Sapphire led a tide of insects, it was different here after all. The only accessible area were mostly barren mountains, and you would usually not see many animals. Suddenly seeing thousands of wild rats would be enough to make people shocked.
The wild rats in the back who were also forced to stop also wanted to squeeze forward, but the front was already full of rats. There was no open space to move past. The ones in front who were particularly large, were annoyed that they turned around to bite a few of the ones pushing behind. Seeing this, the other ones on the back all stopped pushing and no longer squeezed themselves forward. They were satisfied to stay at the back, then continued to stare at the top of the tree, staring at the plants being swung by the wind.
Since they could not squeeze forward, the wild rats at the back had to get up, stretching their necks to get a higher view. Clearly, they were lumped on the ground and all were standing up with elongated necks like a pole.
Shao Xuan also saw those plants growing on top of the mountain. They were upright, thick stalks, about a person tall. A leaf blade has a lance-like, narrow appearance and on each stalk, there were several dark golden ears hanging, giving a kind of heavy feeling. When the wind blew, the ears swayed.
The old man stopped, gasping, his nostrils expanding and shrinking, while staring at the highest place on the top of the mountain. He has stopped moving, as if the whole world was left with only the things there.
The old man’s eyes was increasingly full of wonder and excitement. His two fist at his side clenched, and he couldn’t wait to immediately rush over to dig a few stalks away.
“That’s the ‘thousand gold grains’?” Shao Xuan asked in a low voice.
“Yes! Certainly!” The old man couldn’t repress his excitement. He ignored everything around him, immersing himself in his own world and becoming insane. “Haha hahaha! Found it! I finally found it!!”
Shao Xuan’s eyelids suddenly twitched a few times. He was getting a bad feeling about this.
Sure enough, as the old man laughed out, the next moment, the gray wild rats in front of them turned to look over. Their small eyes were letting out a ferocious light, especially those closest to the top whose body shapes were significantly larger than the other wild rats. They were at least two or three times times larger and their eyes were even glowing red with murderous light.
A few of the big wild rats at the top of the mountain looked at the swinging dark golden ears, then turned to look with the same burning eyes at the old man. Suddenly, they angrily straightened up and opened their mouths to make a series of sharp squeaking sounds.
Shao Xuan silently whispered “bad”, then carried the old man as the totem power in his body instantly soared. It was like a magma appeared along his totem lines, accompanied by the vibration in the surrounding air. It shook wild rats that were jumping around. The force under his foot continued as he went down the mountain.
However, they were most likely still taking into account the plants at the top of the mountain, hence, the wild rats were afraid but did not ran down. Perhaps for fear that if they ran away, they would not be back in time to steal a big meal.
On the other side, Shao Xuan carrying the old man ran to the hillside and saw those wild rats did not chase them. He slowed his pace, then put the old man down.
The old man did not look much at the totem patterns on Shao Xuan. At this time, his eyes were only on the plants at the mountain top and nothing else. His every thoughts were occupied by the dark golden ears.
As soon as he was put down, the old man wanted to continue running up the hill but was forced to stop by Shao Xuan.
“Let go! I’m going there! Those are thousand gold grains, thousand gold grains, you know?!” The old man struggled as he roared.
“I don’t care if it’s thousand golds or thousand droppings. I just know the place has been occupied by the wild rats. Do you want to be fed to the wild rats too?!” Shao Xuan yelled.
When the struggling old man heard this, his sanity gradually returned. He repeated Shao Xuan’s words, “Occupied by wild rats?”
As he thought of the wild rats at the mountain top, the old man suddenly got more upset. “No, no, no, those cannot be spoiled by those wild rats!”
Fortunately, he finally returned to reason. The old man paced in a circle, thinking about a way.
“Those stalks are not yet fully ripe and the wild rats are waiting for the last moment of its maturity. We just have to get rid of the wild rats before the stalks mature.” The old man said.
“How do we do it?” Shao Xuan asked. It was not that he has no way. He could force himself past and fight that group of wild rats, but he would also be paying a higher price. After all, those wild rats were a lot and the closest to the top were the big ones, which were more difficult than the others to deal with. Fighting them could not guarantee that the top of the mountain would be intact.
The old man also took into account a variety of circumstances, thinking for a while. His frowning brows finally loosened, then he called Shao Xuan, “Come with me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 361
chapters.content:
C361 – True Genius
Posted on May 20, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
Shao Xuan followed the old man along to circle around the mountain. If they saw the plants they needed, the old man would go and get it.
A low brown grass was cut by the old man. From a growing spiral tree, a skin was peeled. There were even some Shao Xuan had not seen before. The old man also picked some flowers.
“You’re going to…” Shao Xuan asked, seeing the old man’s actions.
“Use it to put down that batch of wild rats!” The old man’s tone was like it was obvious. For those he suspected were the thousand gold grains, he was determined to win and never let those wild rats eat those ears.
“Poison them?” Shao Xuan asked. Those wild rats were many, so if he wanted to poison them, even if he concocted an herbal medicine, the amount should be very large too. Unless he was actually going to concoct a specific drug.
However, the old man did not want to directly poison the wild rats.
“It is useful for them to stay in this barren mountain. If we need more thousand gold grains in the future, we may have to rely on them to find it so they cannot all be poisoned. I am just trying to stun them now.” The old man’s hands were full soon after. Although he actually wanted to pick less as there was not much grass growing in every part of the mountain, but the old man had to in order to concoct something in time. He moved fast, going to places he had in his memory for some of the plants he needed. In a moment, his hands were full.
“I’ll take it, you go on.” Shao Xuan turned his attention to the grass on the old man’s hands.
The old man did not decline. He handed the herbs to Shao Xuan and told him, “Be careful with those. Do not touch the fractures, the grass juice is bad for you too. And don’t take a whiff of it, or you’ll fall first and I wouldn’t be able to put all those wild rats down.”
The two men quickened their pace. Those wild rats’ movement showed that the plant at the mountain top would soon be fully mature. They had to collect everything and seize the right timing.
By following the old man, Shao Xuan had learned a lot of things, but it would be impossible to reach the old man’s ability to get the materials on the spot, when they were rushing for time. The old man would not say a lot, so Shao Xuan could only memorize as they go along. Perhaps he could use these later.
The mountains that seem to be short of trees and weeds everywhere was a treasure paradise for people like old Ju. Whether it’s waste or treasure, that depended on the person. Some plants alone might not have much ability, but together it could be different. What the old man wanted to concoct was a combination of a variety of plants to get the medicine.
“All right, that’s all.”
The old man sat on the ground and began to prepare things to make the medicine.
With a small copper tripod, a few odd-shaped knives, and he would be able to deal with all these.
“Shao Xuan, go to the mountains to get more ‘single-lined fruit’. Find the kind that had a small opening, not something with no opening or has been completely opened.” The old man did not lift his head as he spoke to Shao Xuan. He was busy with his hands and simply did not have the time to look for it himself. He also could not match Shao Xuan’s speed to search for said herb.
“Okay.” Shao Xuan did not ask much too, since he knew what kind of plant the old man was talking about. On the way, the old man had taught him how to recognize it.
Shao Xuan remembered that most of the plants of the “single-lined fruit” grew in the valley between the two mountains. He had seen it quite a few times as he walked along the narrow part of the valley.
A “single-lined fruit” was a kind of shrub, with a height not even reaching Shao Xuan’s waist. This was a shrub the old man himself named.
As he run down the hill, Shao Xuan looked around, then saw a “single-lined fruit”.
The so-called “single-lined fruit” was named as such because when the fruit of this shrub was about to mature, a line would appear on the fruit’s hard shell. Thereafter, as the fruit matured more and more, the line would crack and open, and the inside of the fruit which has a cracked line would dry out until only a small core would be left. When the time came, the crack on the fruit would be snapped and completely open, spewing out the core inside.
Shao Xuan tried once to be hit by the fruit’s core ejected from the shell and it hurt a lot. If Shao Xuan didn’t have a strong body, he might have broken a skin.
In general, when the fruit of this plant had a crack, there would be no other beasts around. In the old man’s words, “When you see those fruit with the line on the shell, you cannot be near, or you will be shot.”
If picked improperly, it would also stimulate the crack on the fruit’s shell and have an early ejection of its core. Therefore, the old man told Shao Xuan how to correctly pick a “single-lined fruit” when he demonstrated it twice.
Compared to the previous two days, there were more fruits with a crack in its shell surrounding the trees. He just did not know which were needed by the old man. Some cracks were still shallow and might not meet the requirements of the old man.
After thinking about it, Shao Xuan decided to cut away a branch with more fruits. After searching for that kind, he cut them, then Shao Xuan went up the mountain again.
The old man said that those wild rats on the mountain was waiting for the ears to really mature, as it was the most perfect moment the wild rats could get from it what they most wanted, so getting it a point earlier wouldn’t do. Perhaps the group of wild rats at the front which were relatively larger than the rest had gotten to eat more thousand gold grains in the past. If they found it themselves, why shouldn’t they eat more of it themselves too?
As he was thinking, Shao Xuan continued up the hill with the branch.
When Shao Xuan arrived, the old man has lit a fire, with various herbs that has been prepared next to it. The copper tripod let out some pungent smell from inside.
“You should stay away from this point.” The old man waved to Shao Xuan. Shao Xuan put the branch down then avoided the area. After all, Shao Xuan did not have the old man’s detoxification ability, so he was afraid that even a smell would make Shao Xuan faint.
Even after just a small whiff, Shao Xuan suddenly felt a little dizzy, so he moved a few more feet away and stood on a higher ground several meters away from the pot.
The fire was very strong that the inside of the copper pot constantly have water vapor coming out. The old man crouched beside it, staring, his eyes did not move a moment away from that small pot. He constantly stirred the medicine inside with a knife.
“All right!”
The old man screamed excitedly. He extinguished the fire, then picked up the branches brought by Shao Xuan and quickly removed the fruit that matched his requirements. He then held a fruit in one hand and the other held a strange knife. He scraped some powder from the small pot, then poured the powder into the small opening on the fruit.
Each fruit was as big as quail eggs, while the gap on the fruit was narrower. But the old man only needed one hand clamped on the knife and use that strange knife to pour powder into the hole without the powder leaking out and being wasted.
No wonder he had so many strange knives. It turned out to be used for this.
After filling one, the old man also covered the opening with a thin layer of almost transparent leaf skin. It’s to not let the powder inside leak out.
His actions quickly filled up the collected fruits with powder and sealed with the leaf skin. The old man finally picked up the last of the filled fruits with the least powder, then looked around.
Not far away, there was a bird on the ground pecking bugs. He looked at that target, then the old man threw it like a bullet. The fruit flew straight towards the other side, then hit the ground, issuing a clicking sound. The fruit completely opened, and the core inside ejected, at the same time, the powder filled in sprayed out.
Shao Xuan saw the bird flutter its wings twice, looking like it wanted to fly away, but after shaking its wings, it fell.
“How is it?” The old man looked at Shao Xuan with a smug face. It was clear that he was very pleased with what he had made himself.
Shao Xuan walked near to look at the fallen bird, then looked at the completely open empty shell, then sincerely commented, “True genius!”
The crazy old man is indeed a genius! （人′?`*）

chapters.title: Chapter 362
chapters.content:
C362 – Got It
Posted on May 24, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
On a dry and cracked land, the more cracks there were on the ground, the fewer plants were growing around. In many places, there were even only stones and dry hard soil that were exposed outside under the sun.
The wind blowing at the top of the mountain was getting smaller, while the sun was scorching on their head. Many of the wild rats in the area had begun to feel thirst, but they still had not left. Their claws were only crawling forward, and not back. As they stared at the changing colors of the ears on top of the hill, their necks would stretch, wishing they could have a better position in order to better see what was on top of the hill.
The ears were changing colors, wherein before it was dark gold, then gradually became a little lighter. The dark surface became shiny, not far from looking like actual gold.
“Squeak—”
Who knew which one of the wild rats called out.
But it was like a sign to act. The crowd of wild rats moved in an instant, suddenly rushing forward.
The big wild rats were about to jump up and bite the ears, when suddenly, they heard a whooshing sound. Something came from behind them.
Then, with a “click”, a bad smell was released around them. The wild rats, who had smelled it, began to go into a trance and walked unsteadily.
That was only the beginning. Soon, a dense clatter sounded around in succession, smashing into the huddled group of rats.
Shao Xuan stopped his breath while the smashing of the fruits continued. He quickly rushed to the top of the mountain to guard there, as he dealt with the rushing rat herd.
The old man has stunned over a large number of wild rats with the medicine. Although he could not solve all the wild rats, his actions reduced the pressure on Shao Xuan in a large extent, as he dealt with the rest of the rats easily. After all, these were only wild rats and not a fierce beast. Shao Xuan reached the stalk, then he was holding a broom tied to a branch on one hand, using it to sweep away the wild rats pouncing on him.
In fact, Shao Xuan much preferred to use some fierce weapon. Just that the old man himself made this broom and said it was useful to deal with the wild rats, so Shao Xuan used it.
Sure enough, after being swept by this “broom”, the wild rats acted as if they were contaminated with something they did not like. They hesitated to approach at once.
Before that though, a big rat had jumped up and took a bite off the ears. After smelling its odor, its desire to get a taste of the grain in its mouth increased. It wanted to just sit on the ground and not move its legs, but it could still carry on a little longer compared to the other wild rats. It knew that things had changed. With the grain in its mouth, it run in the distance. Unfortunately, it was caught by the old man before it could get outside the crowd.
The old man used some of the remaining residue from the previous coating he did on the fruits. He put it around a stick, then lit it and extinguished the fire. The smoke rose above, and the smell of the smoke was more pungent, though the effect was far less than the refined powder in the fruits. It was impossible for the poison to take effect faster, but it was more than enough to deal with these big wild rats now.
Seeing Shao Xuan block the mountain top with a lot of wild rats surrounding him, the old man was reassured, so he concentrated on dealing with the rat that managed to sneak away. This one must have bitten grains in its mouths! The rat’s mouth was moving, and it’s staring at what what the old man was about to do now.
When Shao Xuan was finished, the top of the mountain was like it has been poured by large wild rats. It’s like a layer of rat skin rug.
As for those who had escaped the drugging, as they rushed up, Shao Xuan swept them away with the broom.
The old man settled the running rat, then immediately ran towards the mountain top next to the plant. He carefully touched the bundles of ears. Because he was not sure whether this was an annual plant, he dared not chop it nor call Shao Xuan to cut it all off earlier and not stay here to scramble with those wild rats.
He raised his hand then chopped a little harder, and the old man finally had an ear of grain off.
He put the whole grain inside his cloth bag, then the old man called to Shao Xuan, “Let’s go. The rest of the wild rats will leave too.”
Without waiting for the old man to finish his sentence, Shao Xuan already waved his broom as he jumped down. After a few jumps, he did not leave the area, but jumped in the rat circle. Shao Xuan fished a few fat wild rats for his meal later. It was difficult to look for larger beasts in this barren area, hence it was not easy to eat meat regularly. He had to take advantage of this opportunity to catch a few.
“You only took a stalk away. Would those few left still remain here. Aren’t you afraid it’ll be destroyed by the wild rats? It wouldn’t be a problem?” Shao Xuan asked the old man. If the old man didn’t care about those plants and it has no value for research, Shao Xuan would not be so laborious earlier and cut it with a knife without troubling about it.
“Those wild rats wouldn’t be interested in it now. They only wanted to eat these grains. As for the few left there, they were rooted too deeply and would not be easy to dig out so it was not convenient to take away… Forget it. Next time, I’ll bring someone over when I get back.” As long as those trees did not wither before he brought others here, he would transplant them all in his field and study them well.
“Then, if the drugged wild rats woke up, wondering why they fainted, aren’t you afraid they’ll retaliate?” Shao Xuan followed.
As he held the cloth bag with the grains like a baby, the old man raised his eyebrows when he heard Shao Xuan question. “Revenge? Why should I be afraid? The next time I come, I won’t give them a chance to retaliate.” Next time he came over, he must bring more people, so he didn’t fear the wild rats.
Afterwards, they left that mountain, then found a place to sit down to rest. Shao Xuan reached out to the old man. “Take out the grains and let me see. Show me that legendary thousand gold grains you’re talking about, that you would ignore the group of wild rats just to see it.”
The old man hesitated and did not open the bag containing the grains. However, he still took a piece of ear out of the other smaller bag and put it in Shao Xuan’s hand.
Shao Xuan looked at it. One grain was about as big as a soybean, with a golden shell around the grain. Above it, there were teeth marks where the rats bit out.
Although a grain was only this big, he could feel its obvious weight, which was heavier than what Shao Xuan expected.
However, it was just one grain, and Shao Xuan couldn’t tell its importance.
“Well, I share credit for this. Can you give this to me?” Shao Xuan said, pinching the damage ear, as he looked at the old man.
“What do you want this for?” The old man asked as he ordered his stuff.
“Eat it.”
Hearing this, the old man’s eyebrows suddenly raised high up. “Eat it?!!”
“Aren’t these kind used as food?”
“But we haven’t started to grow a lot of this species yet! These intact ones can only be used as seeds, but cannot be eaten!” The old man has a very firm attitude.
“Then, divide it with me, and I’ll go back to my tribe and plant it.” Seeing that the old man was about to decline, Shao Xuan spoke first. “Even if I don’t know how to plant it, our tribe must have someone who could learn it. Don’t be stingy, come on, split it. Anyway, that one has thousands of grains, with still so many stalks on the mountain top. Even if the wild rats take some, you could still get who knew how many tens of thousands of grains. So give me half.”
“Half?!” The old man stared at him. “Impossible, never. I can give you a third, but a half is too much!”
“That one couldn’t be equally divided in thirds with only a thousand grains each.” Shao Xuan said.
The old man choked on his breath. He did not speak, but the wrinkled skin on his old face kept twitching. He seemed to be thinking hard about it.
Finally, the old man gave Shao Xuan 1000 grains. As he cut the ear, his appearance was like his heart was shivering with regret, like he had foreseen that these grains would only be spoiled inside Shao Xuan’s belly in the end.
“If it hadn’t been for… If it hadn’t been for your help in this journey, I wouldn’t have given you one!” The old man said with a bitter face.
“Hey, don’t be so negative. Maybe you can’t grow it, and I’ll be able to instead?” Shao Xuan replied.
The old man only vigorously shook his head. He didn’t believe that would happen in any way.
Not sure if I got the split of the grains right. ˉ_(ツ)_/ˉ

chapters.title: Chapter 363
chapters.content:
C363 – Advice on the First Slave
Posted on May 27, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
For some things, the old man might not say much since he cared for few, but the “thousand gold grains” was one of those he cared about. In the old man’s heart, it still has a large proportion, and those who knew that he worked hard a lot for it, even running all the way to this desolate land to find it, should know.
If Shao Xuan bargained again, regardless of what others would say and even if he had to directly fight him, the old man would rather die than agree. A thousand grains was his last concession.
“I said I would compensate it with something else, but I don’t have much on hand right now so I can’t give it to you yet. In this way, if you have time in the future, go to King City, give them my name and I will give it to you there.” The old man said, handing Shao Xuan a crooked little bronze knife shaped like a smaller sickle. “This is for you. If you go to King City, you can take this out and someone would take you to me.”
King City?
Shao Xuan raised his head from looking at the knife, to look at the old man. “What is your full name?”
“This old man is called Ji Ju!”
Ji? Shao Xuan heard that that was the name of the king of King City, a city of aristocratic slave owners. Many of the surnamed Ji now has the most slaves among the slave owners, and the surnamed Ji in King City were also transforming the former tribes to slaves. Later, the five largest tribes also gathered there, and took the “Ji” as the name of their people.
Long ago, in this land, tribesmen discovered another way to use the fire. With this, some tribesmen become slave owners, building city-states, while others still maintained a tribe.
“Have you always enslaved a lot of slaves?” Shao Xuan asked as he put the fine grains that Ji Ju handed over in his animal skin bag.
Since he’s one of the slave owners with the largest lands, there should be quite a few slaves working under them. However, Ji Ju’s answer was not so. “There are many slaves under me, after all, I have more land and it has to be taken care of. However, the slave I have personally enslaved is only one.” Ji Ju said with pride on his face.
Ordinary slaves and personally enslaved slaves have the same distinctions between them as beasts and engraved beasts raised in the Flaming Horns tribe. It depended on the degree of closeness. Shao Xuan had heard about this in his travels, so there was not much surprise about this. However, it surprised him that Ji Ju only enslaved one.
“That must have been a powerful slave.” Shao Xuan said.
“Naturally, Kitochi is a very good slave. He can help me take care of my fields.” Speaking of that, Old Ju had some thought of his slave.
“Kitochi? How could a person have such a name?” Shao Xuan asked.
“This is a very good name. I gave it myself!” When Shao Xuan questioned it, Old Ju’s face showed that he disagrees. “And who says Kitochi is human?”
“Then what is it?” Shao Xuan was curious of a slave owner of this age only having one slave on hand, moreover, the only slave was not actually human.
Old Ju looked proud of it. “Moo—”
Shao Xuan: “…Moo? A cow, huh?”
“Yes! Don’t you think this slave is particularly good?! It was when it was still little when I enslaved it, and I had a large field in my hands that was in its care.” Old Ju had a big smile on his face.
“I’ll see it when I have the chance.” Shao Xuan said.
As he talked about his own beloved slave, the old man’s depressed state disappeared. His eyes lit up like a torch and the smile on his face did not diminish. His attention shifted from the thousand gold grains to his own slave, and old Ju said a lot.
“I tell you, Shao Xuan, if you want to enslave slaves in the future, you must pay attention to your first slave. That’s because the first slave will most likely be the most loyal one, and would also have the closest connection with your consciousness. Even if the other slaves were better, it will always be closer and this is a commonality in slavery. So we, slave owners were very cautious in choosing our first slave. Some were not even able to enslave slaves until middle age because they could not find a satisfactory first slave.” Old Ju also mentioned the topic on slavery, seeing as Shao Xuan had helped him so much. Additionally, because of him, he found what he suspected was the thousand gold grains, hence, he was in a good mood and adviced Shao Xuan.
“Of course, many of the tribesmen may not be able to be slave owners. You people don’t have much interest in enslaving slaves either. Besides, it’s unlikely for most to succeed, and not many have the knack of mastering it.” Old Ju said.
Hearing the old man’s words, Shao Xuan had an eccentric expression on his face. “The first slave is very important?”
“Extremely important!” Old Ju was adamant about it.
“From thousands and thousands of picks?” Shao Xuan asked again.
“That’s best.”
“Can’t just enslave anybody?”
“It’s not something to mess around!”
Old Ju continued to advice Shao Xuan. “How can one just enslave at will?! Once, when our ancestors did not know that the first enslaved slave was the most special, they did not pay attention to it so much that there were more betrayal from slaves. The enslavement of slaves resulted to their own characteristics and strengths which became scattered, hence, they were not loyal enough. The connection to the owner’s consciousness was not tight enough. Therefore, they learned that their own slave were more special, especially the first slave.”
Knowing the situation on this side and its difference with the desert on the other side, Shao Xuan did not ask more, just thought of his first slave… He did not mean to talk to old Ju about it. He had actually enslaved before and his first was a dung beetle, just to casually test out his power.
No wonder the blue beetle was so loyal. Shao Xuan could clearly feel the beetle’s current state as of now. Although it could not know what it was doing now, he was sure that Sapphire was now living well, getting stronger and stronger, so he did not need to worry about it.
Half way through it, old Ju realized that tribesmen had neve really been interested in slavery. That many tribesmen were generally more exclusive, especially those from the great tribes. That even finding a companion from a foreign tribe was said to require repeated scrutiny by the tribesmen. That the review would not necessarily be accepted immediately.
“You tribesmen are just full of it. Anyway, which tribe are you from?” Old Ju has been forgetting to ask Shao Xuan this question.
“The Flaming Horns tribe.” Shao Xuan replied. On the way to accompany old Ju on this journey, he listened to the old man about his opinion on some tribal stuff. One of which he mentioned was the Flaming Horns, but he did not have much to say about them. He was not hostile to them, just not having a very good impression. In any case, Shao Xuan was very happy when he heard old Ju mention the Flaming Horns tribe.
“Which one?!” When he heard Shao Xuan’s answer, old Ju wished to dig out his ears.
“Flaming Horns.” Shao Xuan repeated.
“……Give me back the thousand gold grains!” Old Ju reached out to grab it. “Aren’t you people hunters? How can you take good care of these thousand gold grains?!”
Although the people of the Flaming Horns tribe go to the King City even less, visiting one or two times would make people remember them. In the old man’s impression, the Flaming Horns were strong, that a person could carry a few bears while tossing them around to play. However, their characters were rude and violent, that their every return to the city would always make a few aristocrats angry. They were already banned by six aristocrats. However, these past years, the Flaming Horns tribe did come out a lot. Old Ju once saw the people of the tribe when he was young, and now, the younger generation may not have seen them ever.
“We, the Flaming Horns tribe can also farm on our land!” Shao Xuan argued. The history of the tribe also recorded a lot on planting. It was impossible that even in this place, they were not good.
“Can farm, my ass!”
Old Ju felt regretful now, but unfortunately, he had already decided to give out the grains. Even if he wanted to retrieve it, it would not be returned.
When his attempts were fruitless, Old Ju finally gave up. Fortunately, his current focus was not here. He has to hurry back, then bring those thousand gold grains back to his people. King City was not even close to here.
Soon, old Ju would have to go to one direction while Shao Xuan to another.
“By the way, do you remember where the Flaming Horns tribe is?” Shao Xuan asked before they separated.
“Why, are you lost?” Old Ju laughed, but he really did not know the specific location of the Flaming Horns tribe. “I only know that they should be in the depths of the mountains, from here, it should be a little farther away. You should find them yourself.”
Sapphire is still the best! (′^ω^`)

chapters.title: Chapter 364
chapters.content:
C364 – Exaggerated Necklace
Posted on May 31, 2019 by AzureOrchid92
After separating with Old Ju, Shao Xuan continued to travel along his target direction, knowing that the Flaming Horns tribe really were there. His heart was a lot more solid. Even if he was far from the Flaming Horns tribe, Shao Xuan still felt relaxed on the road.
Without Old Ju, Shao Xuan’s pace sped up a lot. Midway, he saw some plants. He made a few herbal concoctions, poisonous as well as healing drugs were prepared from what Shao Xuan learned from the old man.
When he encountered good stones, he also made some spare stone tools. This was the advantage of using stone tools. They could be locally sourced and there was no need to forge it. Shao Xuan also polished a large pot of basin, though actually a lot deeper than the usual basin to use to cook soup and herbs. The stone pot has two left ears on both sides used for a straw rope to pass through and he could carry it on the road, ready for use at any time.
This sparse mountain was indeed very large. Shao Xuan reached the area with dense grass after a while from separating with Old Ju. Over the mountain, he could see the terrain had become flat with a vast prairie view. He did not know whether it was because of the season or there was less rain here, but even though there was a lot of grass here, they were still mostly dry.
Trees suitable for a grassland environment were grouped together or isolated in the middle of an empty meadow, which was also a major feature of the prairie. There was also a river on this prairie, but it is not too big. Along the curved banks of the river, there were walls of trees lined up that he could not name.
Compared to this vast prairie, the growth of the trees where he was was not much. The grass was richer and more varied, that even if Shao Xuan had learned a lot from following Old Ju, he still had more to learn after coming here. Shao Xuan did not have the same detoxification ability the old man has, so he did not dare to eat indiscriminately. He had to make a careful choice. Even something like a seemingly ordinary grass could be secretly hiding a killing machine inside. Sometimes, a humble grass could ask for a human life.
There were wild cattles lined up in formation, grazing slowly on the prairie. Even the sharpest predator on the prairie who wanted to drag a bison out of the herd would still have to think more about how to accomplish that. This group of wild cattle was not easy to deal with. In particular, those on the periphery were significantly larger than those in the center of the herd. Those with black pointed horns would meet their enemy with the sharp point first.
Seeing Shao Xuan, several bison on the periphery stomped using their strong hooves. Their stout and powerful limbs and calf hooves were like iron palms trampling on the grass, easily stepping out of a hoof pit.
They were demonstrating their strength and warning Shao Xuan.
A lion-like predator hidden behind the dry bushes saw the scene, and it unwillingly removed its sight from the herd. It moved to where Shao Xuan was, but, when it caught Shao Xuan’s eyes, the hairs on its back rose. Its intuition told it to avoid this seemingly small human. In the end, it decided to keep guarding the herd and wait for the right moment to launch another attack.
Shao Xuan created a suitable hunting opportunity for the big cat too. He first threw some pungent herbs towards the herd, causing the herd to be restless, then caught the chance to slaughter a bison. Afterwards, he ran away, carrying the cow. Meanwhile, the big cat hidden behind the bushes also took the chance to pick up one.
After roasting the cattle, he ate some. Then, Shao Xuan got the stone pot out and went to the river to scoop some water. After a thought, he threw a few thousand gold grains into the pot, most of which where the ones he got from the old man that were bitten over by the wild rats. In the words of the old man, these species were unlikely to survive with him, so eating it was better.
Shao Xuan also did not care that these grains were bitten by wild rats. He peeled the shell, then threw the golden grains inside the pot to cook it a little. Although there were fewer grains compared to the pot of water, the cooked soup still became a little cloudy yellow. With its faint fragrance, it was very tempting. It was also a good treat to drink such a pot after eating too much meat.
The cooked grain was soft and waxy inside. It tasted good. After the soup he drank went down his stomach, Shao Xuan felt a lot more comfortable. No wonder Old Ju did not care about any beasts in front of this. It was indeed much better to eat this than the flesh of a beast.
But even if it’s good for the body, Shao Xuan only has a thousand grains on hand. One thousand capsules could be considered a lot, but put together, you could only see a little bit. Shao Xuan saying that he wanted to try to plant the thousand gold grains was not just as a joke. He really has this idea, that if he could plant it successfully, later, when he went back to the other side of the sea, he could also take a batch back to improve the life of the tribe.
After eating and having a good rest, Shao Xuan carried his gear and went on his way.
The terrain to the grassland was with slight inclines. At times, he saw raised low hills in the wilderness. Occasionally, he also saw some ant nests.
Shao Xuan stepped into the prairie seven days later.
Under the clear sky, several riders rushed by on the prairie. The tamed horses stepped on the slightly arid prairie, raising up dust on their way. Those people were probably riding with competition against the others in mind.
The people riding on the horses were wearing fur and cloth combined with knitted clothes. Their long hairs were not cut short, woven into a few braids, with men and women having similar hairstyles. Their faces were also painted with some patterns.
Shao Xuan, carrying two roasted bison thighs and a large basin as a stone pot, stepped forward easily on the prairie. Compared to the rapid hooves and tense atmosphere nearby, Shao Xuan appearing here was a contrast, a stranger passing by particularly leisurely. This abrupt change in the scene made the riders notice him even if they didn’t want to.
The young man who was at the front pulled on his horse as he approached Shao Xuan. The man behind him looked too, then the rest stopped in succession, their eyes all looking at Shao Xuan. Two of the young men also drew the dagger in their waists, one pulled it out, while the other placed his fingertips on the knife hanging on the side of his horse.
After the head person swept a circle around Shao Xuan, his eyes became more cautious, but his face was not so serious. With a smile on his face, he went to ask Shao Xuan from which side he had come.
Seeing their leader like this, several other people looked at each other, then changed their guarded expressions. However, the young man who had just touched his knife did not move his hand away, but the one who pulled out his dagger put it back to the holster at his waist. Their sight strayed on the string, an extraordinary necklace hanging on Shao Xuan’s neck and stayed for a moment, then like the others, both exposed their white teeth, smiling at Shao Xuan.
The string of necklaces hanging around Shao Xuan’s neck was actually made of the big horns of the bison, as well as the fangs and claws of other predators. For these people, a person who could hunt these prairie beasts and carry so many easily on their way, was enough to make them think first before they act.
One shouldn’t look down at these people, chatting with Shao Xuan with a friendly smile. Shao Xuan knew it was not good to provoke them, but not provoking them didn’t mean he would make friends with them immediately. He would not fight or kill them directly, but he wouldn’t be the underdog. In such a primitive environment, there were moments like these at all times, which was the reason why Shao Xuan left these souvenirs after hunting to make exaggerated necklaces.
With just a few words with those people, Shao Xuan did not directly say which tribe he was from. He only said that he was out after a training and was going back, but he did not seem to remember the way. He asked about the surrounding terrain, with a cow leg as a reward.
These people’s tribe was just in the vicinity, so they were familiar with the surroundings. After receiving Shao Xuan’s cow leg, they listened to Shao Xuan’s questions about the tribes in the dense mountains. Since they were idle, they pointed Shao Xuan to the right direction. One even got off his horse to talk to him, then lent one and accompanied him. Although they had not been to further places and only reached as far as the prairie area near the tribe, they listened to the elders saying things about that dense mountain areas. When they became more powerful, they would take a chance to travel farther out, so they had learned about some of the important geographical locations around.
“From here, go straight, then climb over a few more mountains, and you should be able to see it.” The leading young man said.
They could only lead the way up to there. It was impossible to go further and there were more danger farther away. Then, they looked at Shao Xuan who looked the same age as them. This person could travel in this perilous prairie alone and also live well. Few of them who were dissatisfied before knew they were no match.
“Thanks.” Then, Shao Xuan got off the horse and organized this equipment to continued walking.
After walk through the prairie and over a mountain range, he finally saw the scenery he wanted to find.
Standing on the high mountain, looking upon the thick green in the distance, breathing the moist air, Shao Xuan then took the stone pot to carry it on his back, then went down the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Assault
chapters.content:
Chapter 365 – Assault
After going over the mountain, Shao Xuan could clearly feel the difference in the environment. The climate on both sides of the mountain was very different. It seemed that the humidity and rain on this side were all blocked by the mountain and could not reach the dry grasslands on the other side of the mountain.
The further Shao Xuan went down, the more familiar he felt.
Although he came here for the first time, the environment reminded him of the mountains of the hunting ground. Both the forest on the other side of the river where the Flaming Horn tribe was originally located, and the Ferocious Beasts Mountain when he returned to the old haunt, were the same as this environment. There was endless green color as far as one could see.
This was a place full of vitality and crisis. Maybe because of the familiar environment or the feeling of getting closer to the Flaming Horn tribe which Shao Xuan felt like he had left for about a thousand years, Shao Xuan became more excited.
While walking down the mountain, Shao Xuan threw away the exaggerated necklace that he wore around his neck. Those which could be used as weapons had already been used and the things that made up the necklace were just claws and horns. The stone pot behind his back which was used to cook the soup was also thrown away, as it would be cumbersome at this moment. Shao Xuan had to be more careful in places like mountains and forests. Carrying as little things as possible would help Shao Xuan avoid danger.
From the time Shao Xuan stepped into the desert, it had been about half a year. It was the first time Shao Xuan entered such a forest since then.
Smelling the odor of moist vegetation and hearing the sound of various birds and beasts, Shao Xuan took a deep breath, stepped lightly and tried to integrate himself into the new environment.
The wide river flowed far into the distance among the dense woods. If one stood on top of a tree, the creatures in the river including dark-backed fish and giant pythons could be seen from time to time.
Shao Xuan could determine the position of the tribe although there was no obvious signal from the inner flame. He took out the bone ornament that symbolized the identity of the elders, hung it around his neck and touched the ball with a red-hot luster in the middle of the bone ornament. Shao Xuan wondered whether his identity could be recognized by the Flaming Horn tribe there.
Cheering up, Shao Xuan continued to march towards that direction.
There were some traces of human activities, such as rags and incomplete weapons that had been abandoned here. Shao Xuan even saw a bone of human beings under a big tree, which probably belonged to a hunter who was killed there.
Carefully discerning the traces around him, Shao Xuan quickly recognized the various creatures there. His steps were cautious, but not slow.
There was a snake hidden on a branch. At first glance, it was difficult to find this poisonous creature. When Shao Xuan passed, it wanted to take a bite but Shao Xuan was too fast and didn’t leave it time to prepare. The snake lurking on the branch spit out poison, adjusted its posture and continued to wait for the next prey.
In addition to the tools used by human beings, Shao Xuan also saw paintings on branches or stones but didn’t know which tribe left them. Some paints were similar to totems, some were words, and others showed off the prey they hunted, telling people who came here, about their power.
Shao Xuan glanced at the paintings. He knew these words but he was not familiar with the paintings and style. These may have been left by other tribes. It is possible that people in the Flaming Horn tribe live farther away, and didn’t come here.
Since there were traces of human beings, Shao Xuan had to be on guard against not only the beasts lurking in the mountains but also other human beings. Sometimes human beings were much more dangerous than beasts.
After entering the forest, the more Shao Xuan went deeper, the denser and stouter the trees were. Walking on the soft land, Shao Xuan could only see the light through the dense branches.
On the third day of entering the forest, Shao Xuan suddenly felt a killing intent when walking in the forest. Although the other party tried to hold back, the feeling was so strong that Shao Xuan noticed it based on his hunting experience.
But Shao Xuan didn’t know whether it was from a human or a beast.
Since the other party had not taken action, Shao Xuan did not take the initiative to attack but continued to move forward, trying to see how the other party hidden in the dark would act.
Speeding up, Shao Xuan shuttled between the woods. The eyesight still closely followed him. Its movements were not slow and it was quite good at concealment. Shao Xuan looked around but could not discover its figure. However, the sound made by the other party while moving was clearly captured by Shao Xuan, even though it was very light and could be easily covered by the sound of the shaking of the branches.
As the wind blew, the branches of surrounding trees swayed and the friction of the leaves made a squeaking sound. Occasionally there were some movements made by birds that flew up or fell.
Distinguishing the movement behind from the various other sounds, Shao Xuan sped up again. He shuttled in the woods like dexterous wind. After seven sharp turns and changes of direction, Shao Xuan jumped up a big tree agilely and hid in the dense foliage.
Some flying insects were on the tree and a spotted flying insect was resting on the treetop. It got scared and almost rolled off the leaf when Shao Xuan suddenly jumped onto the tree. In the trunk, a slender worm, which had been hidden in the unobtrusive cracks on the rough bark, suddenly shot like an arrow at Shao Xuan.
If such a worm bit a person, it would drill directly into the body.
Not turning around, Shao Xuan picked a tree branch and threw it towards the direction of the worm. The branch with sharp edges nailed the long worm to the thick bark.
The long worm that was nailed to the bark writhed its body, as if it wanted to break free, but it couldn’t do anything.
Shao Xuan didn’t look at the worm. His ears carefully distinguished the tiny sound that was coming close and his eyes were fixed in the direction of the sound.
A brown figure shot forward like a shadow. When passing a tree, it paused briefly and then left at a faster speed. It seemed to have noticed that Shao Xuan had hidden deliberately. When the brown figure was about to reach the tree where Shao Xuan was, it suddenly made a turn around a tree and disappeared behind the tree.
Shao Xuan frowned and stared at the direction, but he paid attention to the surroundings. The other party, who was smart and knew how to lurk, had indeed tailed him.
Shao Xuan gripped the black knife on his hand and gathered his attention.
A figure suddenly came from the trunk behind Shao Xuan, cutting off the branches and leaves in front. A sharp cold glare flashed out and killing intent suddenly filled the space around the tree. With cruelty, the glare drew a curve and swept directly towards Shao Xuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - Someone from the Flaming Horns Tribe
chapters.content:
CoPW C366 – Someone from the Flaming Horns Tribe
At that moment, Shao Xuan moved to the side to avoid the attack, then jumped off the tree, directly into the open.
If he wanted to deal with this opponent, it was not suitable to fight in close range. If he was too close, Shao Xuan would only suffer as the other side was quick and has longer reach, so it naturally had the advantage.
It was a strange animal that looked like a larger brown monkey, but in fact, it was not. Its limbs were long and flexible, as well as its feet and toes, but its sharp, sickle-shaped claws could be contracted between its toes like a cat. When it was waving its arms like a whip, the claws were out, but when it was just moving, it would put its claws away.
As it waved its claws towards Shao Xuan, it showed its sharp teeth and glared at him. With its fierce attacks and bared teeth, it was obvious that the ferocious animal was feeling a deep resentment. It was not as if it was catching its prey, but more like fighting an enemy.
This made Shao Xuan puzzled.
The animal was very clever. It was not just one of the big, stupid ones, but a real beast. Even if Shao Xuan wanted to ignore it, the emotions in its eyes were too strong that he could not. It was the first came he came to this place, so he was curious how he had actually offended it.
After coming down from the tree, the space behind him was tight.
In the midst of the murderous killing, the cold light of the beast’s claws was like a raging stalker, waving its sickle of death, eager to harvest all life.
The claws in front of him were too fast that Shao Xuan couldn’t find a good opportunity to counterattack.
As his feet jumped off the ground, Shao Xuan had moved away from his original position, leaving a sinkhole on the ground. Then, the soft rot and leaves in that area burst up as the approaching claw in front turned it into shreds.
Shao Xuan quickly ran by the dense forest, while the pursuer behind him still let out a strong killing intent. It was like it was wishing it could fly over immediately.
Shao Xuan’s speed was already fast, but the other side didn’t have to hide this was, was also catching up. Unexpectedly, Shao Xuan did not get too far!
He tried to dodge but the attack was fast. Each hit of the long and sharp claws was with strong emotion. It was also smart enough that it was no stranger to humans. What would be the best way to deal with such a fierce beast?
There seemed to be a tense atmosphere in the dense forest as a result of this chase. The other beasts had no intention to meddle, nor could they keep up with the speed of both.
The sound a trunk breaking sounded again. It was the work of the fierce beast as he sped up with the help of the trunk. The louder the cut sounded, the greater the force used by the other party, the more it continued to accelerate. It had probably gotten tired of being ignored by Shao Xuan, so it couldn’t wait to finish this.
He considered the way the beast used the trunks. If only the trunks were thinner, it would have broken easily.
Should he cut the trunk before the beast used it?
Shao Xuan slowed down his speed a little, then took a sharp turn. The totem power in his body instantly increased, the flame-like totem pattern almost covering his whole body. The totem power in his body flowed and flooded to his legs, and his leg muscles swelled.
After a sharp turn, Shao Xuan pivoted around and pointed his leg at a tree. He lifted his legs up and kicked!
Ka!
The thick trunk the size of three men was kicked off directly.
The broken trunk crashed straight into the path the brown beast was running at.
With the fierce pursuit of the beast, it did not expect that Shao Xuan would come up with this, after seeing him slow down his speed. It had almost caught up, its claws were already itching, but the next moment it was about to taste blood, it was given such a violent blow.
Peng!
The brown figure was hit by the broken trunk, smashing on the trunk of another tree, which made it give a sharp cry.
However, one shouldn’t underestimate this fierce beast. After all, it is a ferocious beast and its physique is strong. It was hurt when it was smashed like this, but it’s not fatal. Just one step short of a serious injury.
Shao Xuan wanted to strike again afterwards, but the beast reacted quickly. When the trunk fell, it used its forelegs like a whip to wrap around the trunk and circled to avoid a frontal collision with Shao Xuan.
The beast, which had fallen several steps back on the ground, landed on its limbs. Crouching down, it trained its dark eyes at Shao Xuan, as if thinking of something or measuring the situation at that moment.
When Shao Xuan thought that it would attack again, he saw the beast turn away and gave up fighting against him. This was the decision it made after measuring the pros and cons, and found that Shao Xuan may not be an easy person to deal with.
However, even if it wanted to leave this time, it was already too late. Shao Xuan would not let go of a beast who had dared to attack him.
This time, the roles of the chase has turned upside down. The side originally in pursuit was now eager to avoid the fight, while the party that was hunted down became a hunter.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
In the woods, the sounds of the trunk being kicked off came from time to time. Some of the birds resting in the trees were startled and flew. The original quiet of this mountain forest became restless. The fierce beasts, who were walking around, twitched their ears, then went on their way and left. They did not want to meddle in such a savage and violent fight. Anyway, it was not them that were unlucky now, so they’re not going to mix in.
The trunks were constantly kicked off. Although not every time it could directly hit the target, but even if it would not hit, it could still bring a certain amount of obstruction to the brown beast.
At this time, the fierce beast was regretting that he had provoked this person. Originally, it just wanted to vent its anger on this person, but never wanted to kill him. It has always been afraid to start a fight with the human race, but it thought this one was easy to deal with, especially since the human was still young and alone. However, after experiencing that human using such a direct use of a trunk as a weapon, even if its claws were sharp, it would not be able to find a way out between such thick trunks, so it would certainly be smashed.
When one’s mood was messed up, one couldn’t make the most correct response in the first place. The messier it was, the more it would turn more messier.
In the woods, Shao Xuan did not know how long he had managed to catch up with the beast.
Ka!
Another trunk was kicked off, and the timing was so well pinched that it hit the beast directly from the side.
The stout mossy trunk was bounced back by the force, then drove straight down.
The beast was hit once again and let out a cry of pain, as it was smashed to the ground.
After a back-to-back hit by the trunk, the smashed fierce beast did not get up immediately, since it was hit a little hard.
But seeing that the other party still wanted to escape, Shao Xuan picked up the fallen trunk next to him, then dragged it over like a stick.
Peng!
The fierce beast, which had just gotten up, was once again hit.
The fallen beast screamed again, and its cry was no longer the fierce hiss of the previous ones but a series of brief shouts. In conjunction with the pitiful emotions that appeared in its eyes, as if it was begging for mercy, it put its claws away, then curled up with its head in his arms, bowing to Shao Xuan.
When he saw this, Shao Xuan threw out the stout trunk in the open. From a tree, he pulled down a long vine, then turned it into a rope to tie the beast up without waiting for this fierce beast to react. Its whip-like limbs were tied, that even if its claws came out, it could not immediately cut all the vines.
After tying it up, Shao Xuan grabbed it by the neck and raised it to his level.
Feeling the fingers tightening in its throat a little, the beast found it more and more difficult to breath. It was injured and its neck was being choked, so it has a slight sense of powerlessness. It knew that struggling to swing its trapped limbs was also useless.
As he lifted the beast, Shao Xuan wanted to figure out why the beast was so strongly hostile to himself, but suddenly, his ears twitched. He heard a few fast footsteps approaching. It was probably the movement they made that drew these people over just now. People from a nearby tribe? Or something else?
Those people came quickly, and everyone looked burly and eager.
Apparently, they did not expect to see other tribesmen here. The five people who came over then stopped as they saw the fierce beast in Shao Xuan’s hand. One of them wanted to say something but was stopped by his companions. Shao Xuan had his back to them, therefore, the five people could not see his appearance. Shao Xuan was also wearing more clothes in order to prevent getting poisoned in the woods. He had also added a few animal skins over him, and although his clothes and animal skins had broken a bit, it still blocked the totem patterns in his arms and legs, so the five people could not see them.
The five looked at each other, then one of the most calm walked forward. He was ready to say his piece, but Shao Xuan has finally turned around.
After looking at Shao Xuan’s face where the totem patterns has not yet dispersed, the person who wanted to talk got his words stuck. The corners of his eyes twitched, while the others were also the same, staring their eyes out, their hearts roaring.
What is this?! Why is there someone from the Flaming Horns tribe here?!

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Won’t Trade
chapters.content:
C367 – Won’t Trade
Their team had chased the long-clawed monkey up to here, when they had been left behind by the cunning monkey earlier. After losing their target, the team separated to find it and these five people were able to catch up because they suddenly heard the movements on this side and just rushed over.
When they also heard the cry of the long-clawed monkey, they knew that someone had already intercepted the monkey. Naturally, they became anxious, but they never thought that the one who had intercepted their target was unexpectedly someone from the Flaming Horns tribe.
To clearly determined that there were no Flaming Horns following them, this time, from beginning to end, they had closely guarded their actions. In addition, their actions were only to the knowledge of a few people. Even most of the people in their own tribe did not know this, but unfortunately, they still unexpectedly met one from that tribe.
For the person to have come so far in this area, they also could not tell whether it was a coincidence or it was deliberate. Were there no other Flaming Horns members around?
If there were none, with the ability of five of them, they should be able to snatch the prey back from such a young warrior.
The five had started working together for hunting early, so it only took a few eye signals to know what the others were thinking, especially from the man who led them. After a quick exchange of stares with his companions, the leader looked at Shao Xuan.
“I didn’t think I’d run into a Flaming Horns tribesman here. Didn’t you go out to hunt?” asked the man.
Shao Xuan did not reply. The other side had a wrong speculation of him, but he did not want to correct them. If the other side misunderstood or did not understand the situation, once he said more, it would likely make them understand less. It was better to listen first to also get more information.
From the attitude of the five men, Shao Xuan speculated that the tribe in which these people were members of was an opponent of the Flaming Horns? Even if they were not in a hostile state, it was certainly a competitive relationship, therefore, he did not need to be polite. It’s just that the relationship didn’t seem to be too bad that he had to kill them, so Shao Xuan was still thinking on how to treat them.
“How can you get anywhere when you’re not with your Flaming Horns people!” One of them whispered, the mood on his face entangled with anger and helplessness. His tone was a bit rushed.
Although the other side’s voice was not big, the people present could hear it clearly.
Seeing the two opposite groups didn’t seem to have a good relationship, the long-clawed monkey restrained by Shao Xuan, turned its eyes around and made a few barking sounds in his throat. Its tied legs struggled repeatedly, and it acted like it was about to be choked to death.
Unfortunately, Shao Xuan gave no indication at all that he cared. The five people opposite also just swept it a glance, but did not care about its survival.
“I’m really sorry, but Flaming Horns brother, this long-clawed monkey is the prey we’ve been tracking.” The leader said.
The other side’s tone was still peaceful, but not as if they were friends. Even if they had a had time controlling it, Shao Xuan could still see in their expressions their tension, precaution and readiness to fight at any time.
Shao Xuan looked at the man who had just spoken, and raised his chin. “Go on.”
Go on? Go on, what?
The leader paused, thinking that Shao Xuan had not taken the long-clawed monkey seriously, and said, “We can trade with you for other prey, a beast with a lot of meat and about the same level.” His words emphasized “level” and “meat” more, so was that what he was focusing on?
Shao Xuan considered it, then replied to the five men, “I won’t trade.”
“You!” There was a man on their side who couldn’t help it, his hand pointed to Shao Xuan and he threatened him. “What would could you do if we forced you? Now, you’re alone and there’s five on our side!” Anyway, most of the people of the Flaming Horns tribe should be on a hunt in another area at this time. This person must have sneaked out to play. To have run so far, did he follow them on purpose?
No matter what the others thought, the expression on the Shao Xuan’s face changed not because of the threat from other party. “Your five people have not caught it, I see you really have the ability. Now that this long-clawed monkey has been caught by me, it’s now my prey, so what could you do?”
These five people did show a hostile attitude at first, but decided to give the choice to Shao Xuan. When they revealed some friendly relations with this Flaming Horns tribe member, they never thought that Shao Xuan would not only be so direct, but without mercy dismissed their words.
Seeing the others move their feet, Shao Xuan added, “What, you want to steal from me?”
“If you don’t change your mind, I’m going to have to steal it!” The leader did not have his earlier calm expression by then, his eyes suddenly showed a murderous glint. With his strength, a slightly lower ranked warrior facing him would certainly feel a lot of pressure.
But Shao Xuan only smiled. “Just you?”
Enraged by Shao Xuan’s attitude, these people who knew that using threats against the Flaming Horns were mostly ineffective, had long been ready to act.
The bodies of the five suddenly released power, tattoo-like totem lines appeared on them like waves. They have two senior totem warriors and three intermediate totem warriors. If they don’t have the strength, they won’t be able to follow out for this covert operation.
It was clear to these five that the biggest characteristic of the Flaming Horns people was their strong strength. Therefore, it would be a stupid choice to fight a member of that tribe by strength, hence they decided to use something else, like speed, flexibility and their number advantage. Although, compared to most people, hunters were not much in terms of speed and flexibility, it didn’t mean that they were more concerned about their power advantages.
As soon as the five people moved, Shao Xuan had guessed their strategy.
The two senior totem warriors from the five rushed out, one to the left and one to the right of Shao Xuan, trying to close in on him in a flash.
Even facing five totem warriors from unknown tribes alone, Shao Xuan felt no psychological pressure. In order to fight better, he directly threw the long-clawed monkey he had captive towards a stout tree not far from him.
At the same time Shao Xuan threw the long-clawed monkey, the five others became joyful, especially three at the back. Their footsteps changed direction, bypassing the place where Shao Xuan was located and going directly towards the position the long-clawed monkey was thrown out.
Even if its hands and feet were tied by vines, the flexibility of the monkey was still good. Earlier, because Shao Xuan had tightly fastened its hands, even with a little bit of movement, its neck could be directly cut off, so it only dared to show weakness, but dared not exhibit any crooked thoughts. However now, seeing both sides fighting, its brain began to move.
Its body that was thrown in the air turned, as its tied legs adjusted around. When it hit the trunk, its legs played a good cushion, so it did not get injured. Instead, it used this force to bounce off in the open to run away from this mess. It was not that it despised these people. With its ability, it could free itself from the ropes and could certainly get rid of the trouble. It was able to leave these people behind when they tried to hunt it once, so it could dump them again a second time.
But it’s a pity......
After struggling, it could not break free.
Even after trying again, it could not break free.
Although the flexibility of this kind of vine was very strong, it could not be easily ripped off. The long-clawed monkey never thought much about it. Once it was also tied by some tribes with this vine, but it managed to break free easily so he had experience dealing with such vines. Several times it had deliberately showed weakness, then escape to hide in the dark and smile as it watched those people move around, looking for it.
However, it had made a mistake. It thought it would be able to easily break free from the vines after getting away from Shao Xuan’s control, but that was not the case.
No matter how it times it tried, its long claws were unable to untangle the vines, let alone cut it. Naturally, it could not get out of these ropes.
Still tied up, the long-clawed monkey’s ability to move was greatly reduced. It did not know how far it could run for the three people behind it to catch up. Resisting would also be ineffective, or it wouldn’t have run away from these three. These people would get it regardless of whether it was dead or alive.
Therefore, before it was caught again, the long-clawed monkey slowed down to figure out how to escape.
On the other hand, Shao Xuan who was flanked from left and right quickly moved back a few steps to avoid the siege from both sides. As his space tightened with their knife attacks, Shao Xuan’s feet did not stop moving. His body was still backing off, twisting as a knife flashed by, then tilting to the side to avoid the other knife coming by, while nudging his shoulder, to directly hit the first one.
In the face of the collision against Shao Xuan, the other man clenched his teeth hard to meet this blow. How could he say that he himself was a senior totem warrior, if he was afraid? It was only a hit from someone younger than them, and not even one who looked stronger than him. This person was not one of the few of the most outstanding in the Flaming Horns tribe!
Two moving bodies slamming against each other issued a muffled banging sound. If the other side was like a torrent of surging waves, then Shao Xuan was a towering mountain firmly stuck on the ground.
After the collision, the person swung out, his surprise made his eyes twitch rapidly. He had to do a succession of steps to turn the power of this collision off, then he looked at the half-step made by the one who bumped him. Such a result showed that with this hit, he did not occupy the upper hand at all!
Although he knew he could not win, he did not expect that there would be such a big gap!

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Can’t Catch Up
chapters.content:
Can’t Catch Up
After pushing away the person, Shao Xuan didn’t back away, instead, he firmly stood his ground and punched someone else as he turned.
He landed each punch with the strength he used to chop down a tree.
Facing an attack like this, Shao Xuan’s pursuers could only dodge his punches. They wouldn’t underestimate the young man’s strength after seeing the fate of one of their teammates.
People from Flaming Horn were all terrifying, strong monsters!
No matter how much the two complained about the strength of the Flaming Horn tribesman, they eventually reached their goal. They managed to slow down Shao Xuan enough to let their three teammates run away with the beast. No matter how much he chased them, he wouldn’t catch up, right?
As soon as the thought crept into their minds, Shao Xuan changed his target from them to the trio carrying the long-clawed squirrel monkey.
When hunting, speed is essential. Many prey were quick- even a seemingly heavy wild boar would be hard to chase after when it reached its maximum speed. Therefore, the Flaming Horn tribe never neglected the importance of speed when hunting. Many forget the other characteristics of people from the Flaming Horn tribe, they only remember their strength. Shao Xuan’s speed was already comparable to the tribe leaders, Mu Ta and Gui He before. Now that Shao Xuan had improved, he was even faster than before.
So, when Shao Xuan started to run, his pursuers were dumbfounded. They thought to themselves,?
The one that got the monkey, he should be fast, right??
They were right to be worried.
Looking at Shao Xuan slowly creeping up to the trio, the two could only chase up to him, hoping to block him.
Activating all his totem power, his tattoos lit up like flames, energy pulsed through his muscles, he lowered his body as he rushed through the dense forest effectively avoiding anything that blocked his path. His clothes let out a low growl as he ran through the wind. He was so quick that the birds on the tree could not see him passing through, they could only spot the two figures that followed him.
The two pursuers couldn’t help but mutter their frustration as they saw Shao Xuan running through the forest like an agile snake. When did Flaming Horn produce such a monster? If he hadn’t encountered them, when would they hide him until? Were they going to use him for an ambush later on?
Seeing as Shao Xuan got closer and closer to their teammates in front, the two got more nervous. They pushed themselves as much as they could to run faster, one of them even grabbed the weapon he originally intended to use to kill the monkey.
Unfortunately for them, Shao Xuan robbed them of the chance to kill anything.
The terrain in front was uneven, tree roots covered the ground, thick vines were hanging down each tree, anyone would get caught if they weren’t careful. Naturally, the three in front slowed down.
Shao Xuan thought of a plan to catch up to the trio. He could attack from the top.
While chasing after the monkey, Shao Xuan paid attention to how it moved and tried to mimic it. He could have ended the chase earlier but he chose to experiment with his movements. Every time he got close to the monkey, he would climb up a tree to scare it and then closely observe its movements without letting it out of his sight. He continued this cycle until he was used to the movements.
Shao Xuan held his black dagger and struck as he spun around.
The two behind him only heard a ‘chi’ sound as the figure before they jumped high into the air with the help of a tree. The tree he passed by now had an extra set of rather unnoticeable footsteps and a slash across it.
Chi! Chi! Chi!
In the dense forest, following a continuous noise, a figure travelling at lightning speed was completely off the ground. The shrubs, half-decayed leaves, roots hidden beneath fallen leaves were not a problem to Shao Xuan anymore. Even though he was slower than he was on flatter ground, currently he was quicker than anyone else pursuing him or he was pursuing. He could even quickly circle around a tree to dodge attacks from behind.
Noting the way Shao Xuan moved, the duo felt shocked to their cores.
No way ……
He was imitating the long-clawed squirrel monkey’s movements!
Quick!
Quick!
Not quick enough!
Fuck!
We failed!
This tribesman was too fast!
Looking at Shao Xuan get further and further away, the two felt a looming pressure rested upon their shoulders.
The trees in the forests had very few branches for its first seven or eight meters from the ground. The higher it is from the ground, the more branches it had. This was key to how the monkey could escape at such speed in this terrain. It could avoid the obstacles on the ground and the dense web of branches at the top. It didn’t need to follow the tree trunks for its route. But now, a tribesman from Flaming Horn learned its secret.
The duo tried to mimic its movements but they did not get the technique right so instead of gaining speed, they got slower. They didn’t have time to experiment with techniques now so they could only continue running on the ground. When they finally say their three teammates, they were all lying on the ground.
“No major injuries,” After checking the injuries on the trio, the leader felt a knot in his stomach eased.
“Should we thank that bastard for showing us mercy then?” said the other.
The others kept their silence. It was obvious, Shao Xuan did show them mercy, or else they wouldn’t be breathing now. Shao Xuan was superior to them in strength and in speed.
Shao Xuan did go easy on them, considering that these five only wanted to snatch something from him with no intention to kill them.
“Those, was it him?” The leader asked as he pointed at the toppled large trees.
“Yes.” answered the three with grimace. When Shao Xuan struck them to the ground, they wanted to get up and pursue him again but they heard the trees fall down as if he was giving them a warning.
They felt frustrated thinking about it.
“What should we do?” asked someone.
“What else can we do? Meet with the others and tell them our stuff was stolen by someone from Flaming Horn,” said the leader. This was out of character for the leader, he was admitting to his fault! Anything that had fallen into the hands of someone from Flaming Horn would be hard to retrieve. They needed to go back and have a good ‘talk’ with Flaming Horn
They could imagine the spat their tribe leaders would get into and how those from the other tribe would brag. This was all fucking great!
On the other side of things, Shao Xuan took a now spiritless monkey to a quiet spot. He patted its head, “Drop the act, take the thing out.”
The monkey stared blankly at Shao Xuan.
“You still want to act? Show me the thing,” Shao Xuan said as he used the butt of his dagger to tap its shoulder.
If that group of people wanted to bring back this beast no matter dead or alive, they wouldn’t do it without reason. This monkey had something they wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Can’t Snatch it, Can’t Beat it
chapters.content:
